All 35 first low entries reach held support in the goal, 26 upright and nine with at least four controlled support ticks, up from four at C2. Still zero strict quiet held ticks, sustained supported separation or .50 s stable release. Median precontact/first upright support speed .687/.295 m/s, minimum while held in next .16 s .0475 m/s, median relift delay .080 s. The median y velocity just before support is .030 m/s while vertical remains -.617; the next .14 s palm command still advances y 48.7 mm. Carry entry/min clearance 50/-1.75 mm and .100 s additional grip. Three early manipulation digit excursions (thumb DIP/PIP at 1.71–1.85 s) occur with plug contact. Seed 29212 J2 exceeds 1 deg at 7.73 s during detached motion and later touches again. Although later-stage carry pace remains high, post-contact controlled support advances more often. R20 continues to endpoint. Evidence work/r20_c3_low_entry_comparison.json, work/r20_c3_touchdown_followup.json and work/r20_c3_seating_dynamics_exact.json. No gate candidate from this stage.

body.text: R21 tests only the validated release-start curriculum. Its parent is R20 C3 steps_0106746941 with matching Adam, selected for nine controlled held supports on exact deployment starts and no full release. R20 C2 had the strongest carry at 42 but four controlled holds and zero releases even from 53 prepared seated states. R21 adds 50 repeatedly validated quiet held upright supports and their paired actual invalid source camera caches to the unchanged 388-state pool, with the original phase weights and .30 guided share. The retained 50 permit a physical controlled finish on 50 nominal and 44 delayed suffixes. The nearest prepared states differ from R20 C2 full-start first contacts by median 18.7 mm wrist position, 10.3 deg wrist attitude, .393 rad finger RMS, and pose age 3.49 s versus 1.15 s. This is a limited curriculum distribution, with full deployment starts unchanged. Evidence work/r20_c2_seated_state_coverage.json, work/training_reset_pool_validated_release{,_cache}.json. R21 keeps controlled seat and carry braking, four L40S/6144 worlds each, .35 exploration, .000044 LR, sim4 and per-update profiles. It does not enable the optional detached arm or add finger contact to the evaluator. The numeric-failure guard r0276 preserves all finite samples. Run 26 minutes after R20 ends. Predict more quiet supported releases and hand rest, then test full exact order and safety. Diagnostic seat-bank suffix will separately compare the same restored states.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: The endpoint has 64 lifts, 42 turns, 40 carries, zero ordered places and successes, five hardware violations, zero stops and 10 final robot rests in the exact 64-start station. All 40 low entries lead to held in-zone support, 30 reach upright support and 18 hold under 0.12 m/s and 6 rad/s for at least four consecutive controller ticks. All have zero strict quiet held samples, sustained supported separation or half-second quiet release. Twenty-nine of 30 relift before first separation. Median plug speed is 0.702 m/s before touch, 0.333 at touch and 0.0428 at its still-held supported minimum. Median y target continues 51.1 mm after 0.14 seconds. Hardware faults are isolated as two J2 and three in-grip finger excursions. The independent safety check of C4 also found three violating trials, so neither C4 nor the endpoint advances to a gate. The four-device run measured 102,121 active environment steps/s inclusive and 103,951 after the first two updates over 160,963,900 new interactions. Median per-rank update time was 7.603 s physics, 1.878 s controller, 0.706 s sensor, 0.140 s policy inference, 1.973 s resetting, 0.529 s ramp handoff and 1.824 s PPO including 0.373 s synchronization. Forty-one complete sampled contract checks were clean and no capacity overflow occurred. R21 continues the prespecified parent C3 with only 50 separately validated held-seat reset states and their original sensor histories added. The exact evaluator stays frozen.

body.text: R20 C4 r0282 carries on 42 of 64 fixed exact starts with no safety faults, but its independent paired nominal check scores 64 lifts, 37 turns, 35 carries, zero complete places, 13 rests and three hardware-violating trials. One thumb PIP excursion occurs while held at 1.77 s and two J2 travels occur after contact at 4.48 and 18.93 s. The 16 delayed added-middle/ring-contact diagnostics record 16 lifts, nine turns, four carries, no early excursions and four late violations, two in-grip thumb and two J2 after contact. Early ring MCP2 peaks 0.01650 rad outside travel, within 0.02 allowance. This separately constructed contact model is diagnostic. The exact evaluator stays unchanged. C4 will not enter a fresh gate on this evidence. Data: work/r20_c4_independent_diagnostic/scored.json and work/finger_contact/r20_c4_delayed_contact/0/travel_breakdown.json.

Measured an exact post-release rest noise probe before changing exploration. Seven independently feasible trajectories supplied their settled physical state and retained finger targets. With the current package action decoder and two seconds of paired Gaussian noise around zero intended action, safe combined final object and robot rest is 7/7 at sigma 0, 35/35 at .015, 33/35 at .025, 1/35 at .05 and 0/35 at .10, .20 and .35. At .35 median finger range is .306 rad and palm range .0501 m; there are two stops and one violation, versus .0151 rad/.00165 m and zero faults or stops at .015. Small noise applies only to a possible future post-release training study; this control does not establish trained policy success or change the exact evaluator. Work: work/probe_release_rest_noise.py and work/release_rest_noise_exact.json.

body.text: R21 first prepared-seat diagnostic at 36.91M new steps. On 50 physically tested held-seat starts with observed invalid pose histories, the parent produced no quiet releases and stopped in 16. R21 C1 produces one half-second quiet release at 14.30 s, zero final stable releases or complete suffixes, 14 arm stops and one travel event. Six final robot rests in each. New phase-5 initial states account for only about 1.11% of current resets (0.30 times 0.06 times 50/81), so track outcomes by starting phase and consider a higher phase-5 draw share when the matched run finishes. Fixed full-deployment success is zero. Work: work/r21_c1_prepared50_suffix_exact.json and work/r20_c3_seat_suffix_exact_baseline.json.

A disjoint 96-start collection yielded 67 first held supports. Physical replay with coordinated slowing and a hold after four controlled ticks yields 66 quiet capture candidates. Fifteen distinct seeds restore at least .20 s quiet held in both nominal and delayed exact CPU, retaining actual invalid cache ages 1.845–2.707 s. Twelve also restore quiet in Warp with all 15 caches checked. A physical release diagnostic on the retained 12 ends upright with both robot and object rest in 8/12 nominal and 8/12 delayed, with zero faults or stops, though the first contact break is outside the seated mask in every case. Both R20 C3 and R21 C1 release zero sustainably on these 12 independent suffixes. This bank has not entered training and will serve as a separate state-coverage diagnostic. reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: At 72.29M new interactions, the exact fixed starts give 64 lifts, 43 turns, 43 carries, zero places and successes, five travel faults and two measured column clearance stops. Ten final robot rests and 0.256 ms contract p99. All 41 first held supports are in zone, 28 reach upright support and 15 meet four controlled 100 Hz ticks, versus 13 at the first checkpoint. Twenty-six of 28 relift before first separation, one first gap occurs upright supported and no trial reaches sustained supported release or one strict quiet held sample. Median plug speed is 0.701 m/s before first contact, 0.374 at contact and 0.0408 at its supported held minimum. The y target continues 51.7 mm in the following 0.14 s. The two measured column stops are at 2.16 and 2.25 s; the two J2 violations include one in a detached interval with later recontact. The three finger faults include an in-grip thumb DIP, a thumb PIP during brief detachment and a later in-grip index DIP on a retry. No gate. All four GPUs were profiled. The exact station and nominal finger start stay unchanged. The separate exact prepared-seat suffix test remains in progress.

body.text: Queue a matched measurement of live PPO batch size immediately after R21 completes. Each 16-update run resumes the same R21 C2 actor and Adam with the same release bank, reward, seed, randomization, 80-step rollout, minibatch and profiled four-device setup. Only worlds per GPU change from 6144 to 8192. Compare active steps/s including startup and separately after two updates, the first horizon reset wave, normalized physics and controller cost, optimizer and collective time, capacity and contract traces. Both batch-size studies use the existing training station and are throughput-only. Exact checkpoint evaluations and future gates remain on the frozen CPU station. Queue session 70966; work/compare_live_ppo_batch.sh and work/throughput/release_batch_check_{6144,8192}.

The second R21 policy also has zero half-second quiet releases or complete suffixes on the same 50 prepared held-seat exact starts. Four final robot rests, three travel faults and ten arm stops. Across the first two checkpoints, this curriculum addition alone has yielded a single transient quiet release. The new optional guided stage weights use the original probabilities by default and preserve 70% full resets at the current schedule. A million-draw CPU sampler check gives release shares 0.06084 and 0.31850 among 300349 guided draws for requested .06 and .32. Training diagnostics now retain initial guided phase so future checkpoints can distinguish these starts from episodes that earn the stage. Files work/r21_c2_prepared50_suffix_exact.json and work/guided_stage_weights_check.json.

The exact no-reset diagnostic on 12 selected independent learned prefixes passes all four ordered criteria through final rest in eight of 12 with zero stops or travel faults. It preserves each measured prefix under its original start and replays coordinated targets at .52 or .35 speed near the seat. After quiet held support for .20 s it opens toward the deployment hand and withdraws. All 12 reach quiet held support and all have qualifying lift, turn and carry. This is an offline counterfactual on selected prefixes with privileged diagnostics. The current network still completes zero full trials. The actual grasp can support seating and release when the motion slows and settles. The commands are absent from PPO training. The experiment is in work/r20_retimed_12_full_diagnostic.json.

Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist

reward_terms.name: reference_posture

reward_terms.name: reference_contact

The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height.

body.reflection: At 155.18M new steps, the exact 64 starts give 64 lifts, 44 turns, 38 carries, zero placements or successes, three trials with travel faults, one commanded column-clearance stop, three final robot rests and 0.273 ms contract p99. Thirty-seven reaches have held in-zone support and 30 reach upright support. Twenty-two meet four consecutive controlled ticks and four register at least one strictly quiet held sample. Median speed before, at and during the held minimum after touch is 0.714, 0.300 and 0.0323 m/s. Median time until support is lost while held is 0.135 seconds, and palm target y continues 44.2 mm in 0.14 seconds. Twenty-eight relift before first separation and zero sustain support at release or quiet upright release for 0.50 seconds. The run raised controlled supports from 9 to 22 and quiet held trials from zero to four relative to the parent. The addition alone has not produced full placement. Four L40S over 83 updates measured 98,955 active steps/s including startup and 102,342 after two updates. Median per-rank update time was 7.653 s physics, 1.877 s controller, 0.705 s sensor, 0.139 s inference, 1.980 s resetting, 0.521 s ramp handoff and 1.816 s PPO including 0.357 s cross-device synchronization. Thirty-eight completed sampled contract audits were clean. Peak constraints 152 and shared contacts 90,962 with no capacity overflow. Exact evaluation and the retained pre-grasp start remain frozen. No gate from this run.

body.text: R21 endpoint improves exact controlled held supports from 9 to 22 and produces four isolated quiet held samples. From the 50 prepared held seats it still makes zero quiet or complete releases, with 11 robot rests, four travel faults and eight stops. Resume its network and matching Adam to test phase-5 reset frequency. Raise the release share of guided resets from .06 to .32 with weights .246 .152 .123 .101 .058 .32. Keep 70% full deployment resets, the same 438 physical states and observation histories, the same reward, sensor, physical variation, .35 exploration and .000044 learning rate. The additional 50 held seats then account for 5.93% of resets. Evaluate prepared-seat release and exact full-task placement against the existing fixed starts. The last gate r0259 showed initial acquisition and loss by 4.38 s on seeds 1019263533 and 1122658388. Choose environment count after the separate matched throughput comparison. The independent 12 held states and the prospective partial-release snapshots stay outside this run.

Matched four-GPU PPO sizing results across 16 updates each. 6144 worlds per device measured 100915 active steps/s inclusive and 112846 after two updates. 8192 measured 117856 inclusive and 131555 after two updates. Normalized physics cost was 14.88 and 13.44 microseconds per rank-active step. First full-horizon reset wave rates were 117948 and 137587. Capacity overflows were `False` and `False`. Sampled contract issues were 0 and 0. R22 uses 8192 worlds per device, along with the planned phase-5 reset emphasis in r0300. Policy weights from timing studies are excluded. The short baseline overlaps a separate CPU-only suffix probe. The exact evaluator remains frozen. Full timing and profiling evidence is in work/throughput/release_batch_check_comparison.json.

A fixed-weight uniform target-increment diagnostic on 32 separate nominal starts compared factors 1.00, .75, .60 and .45 for palm translation, rotation and fingers. Over six seconds the exact lift/turn/carry counts are 32/21/21, 32/22/20, 26/10/1 and 28/0/0. There are zero sustained supported releases in each. The .75 factor reduces median vertical speed at low entry from .647 to .524 m/s but reduces four-tick controlled supports from ten to five and adds one clearance stop. Smaller factors lose the learned turn or carry. The retimed command replay result does not transfer through a fixed action bound on the existing closed-loop policy. The original decoder stays in training and the variation is diagnostic only. Evidence is in work/r21_uniform_action_rate.

The exact replay of R21 C1 prepared seat row 42 reproduces its quiet release from 14.30 to at least 14.80 s. The unmodified actor recontacts at 17.17 s and ends upright outside the goal at y=.12663 m. A diagnostic hold of the last commands after 14.80 s postpones recontact to 19.11 s and ends with the plug quietly in goal at y=.11906 m. Finger range .00470 rad meets rest, but palm range .00960 m exceeds .005 m. Both trials are free of stops and travel violations. One selected prepared state shows why maintaining safe separation and arm rest need direct attention after release. Evidence is in work/r21_c1_transient_release_hold_diagnostic.json.

A later release curriculum now has 19 physically validated partially opened starts and their actual invalid camera histories. A continuously moving opening yielded 35 captures and zero stable restores. Pausing a partial opening gives 205 candidate snapshots, 173 exact CPU hold passes and 50 selected sources. Thirty-six stay held quietly for .20 s in Warp. Nineteen stay held through four-second fixed targets and also reach object and robot rest under deliberate release in both exact nominal and delayed dynamics. All 50 cached ages restore at float32 precision. On the retained 19 in Warp, hold produces zero quiet releases, while gentle and fast opening reach 19 each in both dynamics. Their short combined-rest counts are 19 and 19 nominal and 13 and 17 delayed. Random actions produce zero combined rests. This bank stays outside R22. See work/paused_release_verified_opening.json and work/paused_release_verified_opening_warp.json.

On the same R21 C1 row-42 replay as r0303, smoothly matching the measured palm pose after the half-second quiet release yields no recontact and final combined rest, finger range .00170 rad and palm .00293 m. Continuing a smooth upward withdrawal by 65 mm also avoids recontact and preserves the plug but gives .00517 m final palm motion, slightly above the .005 criterion. Both end at y=.11857 m with no stop or travel fault. This isolates the effect of subsequent arm motion in one prepared-state replay and leaves the actor unchanged. Evidence is in work/r21_c1_transient_release_finish_controls.json.

Thirty-seven reach held support in zone, 30 upright, 24 controlled for four controller ticks and four reach a strict quiet held sample. Twenty-six relift before first separation and none sustains upright supported release or a half-second quiet release. Median speeds before, at and at the minimum while still held after touch are 0.731, 0.324 and 0.0317 m/s. Target y advances 51.2 mm over the following 0.14 seconds. Five arm and three finger travel events. On the 50 prepared held seats the actor still releases zero quietly and has nine final robot rests, two travel faults and seven stops. On the separate 12 retimed-grasp held-seat states outside training, one checkpoint suffix reaches full final object and robot rest in the exact station, while the parent has one transient quiet interval and zero complete suffixes. This is evidence of release from a prepared held state. Full-deployment placements remain zero. All four GPUs were profiled. The evaluator is frozen.

body.text: A release observation study is ready if R22 plateaus. Compute each measured finger angle minus a nominal unloaded expectation from previous contract targets, with a 2 Hz filter and interpolated delay from the public command and proprioception timing. Near detachment on 190 nominal traces across R20 through R22, maximum non-thumb residual ROC area is .869–.900 after accounting for the servo response, compared with .674–.770 from the current target alone. It is .933 versus .782 on an independent nominal set and .707 versus .634 in 16 delayed added finger-contact diagnostics. These true contact labels are used only for offline assessment. The optional input appends 20 residuals to the same network, without adding a contract field or clock. Zero-padded input weights and Adam moments preserve parent actions within 9.44e-8 on 320 observations and accept an optimizer update. Packaged and batched features agree within 7.16e-7. The contract probe passes with .510 ms p99. R22 remains unchanged. Evidence is in work/late_grip_hand_tracking_signal_heldout.json and work/hand_tracking_feature_parity.json.

R22 C3 has two nominal fixed-start finger excursions and zero arm travel faults or stops. Both finger events occur while the plug touches the hand and table after the turn. At 1.54 s seed 63979 measured pinky DIP 1.42021 rad with 1.11609 target. At 1.51 s seed 986605 measured pinky MCP2 -.32144 rad with +.25 target. In each case that joint stayed within travel over the previous 40 ms. The pair occurs late during plug support in the exact model. It is distinct from the operator-observed pregrasp middle and ring contact. A small hard target cap or penalty on earlier positive overshoot would miss the observed contact-driven excursions. Evidence is in work/ppo_gpu_22_release_priority_eval_03/finger_travel_details.json.

On 12 independent held-seat suffixes there is one transient quiet release, no final stable release, two robot rests and zero travels and stops. The earlier candidate completed one suffix. body.text: R23 will continue R22 C3 and its matching Adam with a speed-weighted carry milestone. R22 C3 has 42 exact carries, 28 controlled held supports, two contact-driven pinky violations and zero full places. C4 improves carry but reaches 11 violations and makes zero completed held-seat suffixes. Completion remains flat after the reset frequency study even though the earlier stages and training proxy improve. In r0259 seeds 1019263533 and 1122658388 acquire by .46 s and are detached on the table by 4.38 s. The precise fixed-start traces put the main release obstacle at a fast held approach and subsequent relift. The optional bonus multiplies the same carry milestone by the current velocity quality. It requires at least 5 mm net object and target travel toward positive y and measured palm travel at least half as far as the object. This removes any carry bonus for fixed commands even when restored states drift. The built-in integration check matches the diagnostic formula on 136 Warp controls, leaves stage transitions and dense carry terms identical, and pays zero held-static, 11.99 median gentle and 9.19 quick conditional handoffs, without safety or capacity events. All four GPUs and 8192 worlds each. Keep the same .32 release reset emphasis, physical bank, noise and all other rewards. Sensor residual, new pause states and detached reserve remain separate. The exact station stays frozen. Evidence is in work/causal_speed_weighted_carry_bonus_warp.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians.

reward_terms.name: stop

Median speeds before touch, at touch and at the still-held minimum are 0.725, 0.309 and 0.0248 m/s. The parent values are 0.747, 0.353 and 0.0237 m/s. body.text: Matched R22 C3 factorial diagnostics use the same 16 starts and sensor seeds. Nominal, delay plus compliance, added middle–ring contact alone, and their combination give 11/15/6/8 turns, 10/13/5/5 carries and 1/11/0/12 digit-violating trials. There are zero arm faults or stops. Early ring excursions through .45 s peak .00840/.02036/.00819/.01634 rad, with one exceedance in the delay-plus-compliance condition. Added contact reduces turn and carry in this small simulator bracket, and the changed delay plus compliance explains most of the late excursions in the combined bracket. The revised start still needs target confirmation. The exact evaluator remains frozen. Evidence is in work/r22_c3_contact_factorial_exact.json.

A matched exact-state diagnostic on the 12 independent retimed held seats tests R22 endpoint means with latent sigma 0, .15, .25 and .35. The deterministic 12 have zero quiet releases and three final robot rests. The 24 trials at each nonzero sigma have zero, one and zero final quiet releases, and zero robot rests at every nonzero sigma. The one .25 trial holds the object at rest but fails robot rest. `None` completes the full suffix. Hardware counts 1/0/2/1 and stop counts 0/0/1/0. The training proxy can improve while the deterministic exact release lags. This does not justify simply adding noise to deployment. Evidence is in work/r22_endpoint_retimed12_noise_sensitivity.json.

The matched R22 C3 bare-model split isolates a broad difference in this simulated bracket. Nominal has one digit-violating trial out of 16. Changing only stop compliance from .002 to .010 gives 16, of which one exceeds travel by .45 s. Changing only arm delay from .085 to .1075 s gives zero. The combined bare variant gives 11, added contact alone zero, and combined delay, compliance and contact 12. Turn/carry under compliance alone are 10/10, delay alone 11/11, compared with nominal 11/10. This is sensitivity to the chosen simulator parameter and does not measure the station compliance or reproduce the operator-observed pregrasp mechanism. The exact evaluator is unchanged. Evidence is in work/r22_c3_contact_dynamics_separated_exact.json.

On shared starts that reach upright held table contact for both R22 C3 and R23, the first two weighted milestones show small conditional changes. The 24 and 22 matched supports give median precontact speed changes -.021 and -.008 m/s, contact speed changes -.034 and -.041, and median y-target changes -.108 and -.033 mm during the following .14 s. Bootstrap intervals cross zero for each. The unpaired changes over all supports also reflect selection. In the evaluated checkpoints, the post-touch lateral target still advances about 52 mm and complete placement remains absent. Data are in work/r23_paired_touchdown_vs_parent.json.

A separate release-phase relift term is supported by the exact traces. From the first four controlled support ticks to first hand separation, the median peak object height above standing is 1.7 mm on the three measured feasible successes and 78, 76, 58 and 95 mm on R22 C3, R22 endpoint, R23 C1 and R23 C2. A prospective .075-point charge per 100 Hz tick scales linearly between 12 and 37 mm above standing while an already seated object is held off support, capped at 3. The successful examples pay zero. Medians for those learned checkpoints are 1.46, 1.55, 1.27 and 1.55 points. This acts on the post-touch relift with no charge for brief support loss close to the tabletop. Further physical hold, release and relift controls are required before training. Evidence is in work/prospective_relift_cost_exact.json.

body.text: Post-seat relift matched test. On 50 physically prepared seats in each of nominal and delayed Warp dynamics, all 100 deliberate still-held relifts reached the 3-point cap. All 100 fixed holds and all 200 gradual/fast openings paid zero relift cost. The opening controls retained positive release reward in 200/200, with 50/49 combined rests nominal and 43/39 delayed, zero travel or stops in these intentional controls. Random controls paid median 1.777/1.233 points; no capacity errors. Tensor tests pass for eligibility, height taper, active mask, detached grace, cap and reset. Evidence work/seated_relift_{tensor_checks,warp_controls}.json. Prospective hypothesis is that reducing the measured held vertical rebound after confirmed upright support raises sustained quiet release. This is isolated from current R23.

body.text: R24 tests the bounded held relift charge from r0322/r0324 using R23 C3 r0325 and its matching Adam state. C3 has 48/64 fixed carries and one measured late J2 fault, with zero sustained supported releases. C4 has 49 carries, four travel trials and zero releases. In C4, 29 of the 30 supports controlled for four ticks subsequently lose table support before sustained release. R23 reaches more held low carries, yet the exact controlled-to-release transition still fails. Reopened r0259 gate failure montages for seeds 1019263533 and 1122658388 around 06:54 UTC. The plug is among the fingertips at 0.46 s and lies separated on the table by 4.38 s while the hand continues to move. We test keeping the settled plug on its support with less held height rebound, then expect more sustained upright separations in exact evaluation. R24 changes only the optional reward term. Four devices, 8192 worlds per device, same resets, PPO settings, simulation and frozen CPU evaluator. Publish every exact checkpoint and apply the established safety gate.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. body.text: R23 C3 revised-start geometry r0325. Bare hull spacing at least 1.739 mm through first opposition on all 64 fixed nominal traces. After opposition, 46 develop overlap by .45 s, maximum 3.944 mm. Same 16 fixed scene and sensor draws with the added middle–ring pairs and .1075 s arm delay/.010 rad stop-compliance bracket give 16/11/9 lifts/turns/carries, six digit-violating trials versus twelve on the parent in the same bracket, zero early digit breaches, zero arm faults and stops, early ring max .01624 rad. Nominal paired 16 give 16/10/10 with zero violations and stops. Separate independent exact64 gives 64/48/48 and five finger violating trials, zero stops or placements. No dev gate for this checkpoint. Files work/finger_contact/r23_c3_exact_geometry.json, work/r23_c3_contact_comparison_exact.json and work/r23_c3_independent_diagnostic/scored.json. Controlled-support observability. A diagnostic regularized linear probe fitted on 8546 exact samples across 52 scene seeds, including 536 controlled positives, used only the existing four contract frames with the .80 s stale mask. When labels are four preceding eligible controller ticks, existing features distinguish controlled support within the near-seat held cohort at masked ROC AUC .989 on withheld same-distribution scenes and .980 on 64 independent R23 C3 scenes. Added signed hand servo residual gives .988/.978, nonlinear palm and target speed magnitudes .991/.983. The R19 independent traces supply no qualifying positive samples, so only specificity is measured there. This probe supplies no model weights, observation state or actions to the policy. Late detachment is the separately measured residual signal in r0308. The present probe lowers priority of adding residuals solely to recognize a controlled seat. work/seat_observation_signal_exact_v2.json and work/measure_seat_observation_signal.py.

Per-rank medians per update physics 9.072 s, controller 2.172, sensor .719, inference .142, resets 2.072, ramp .545 and optimizer 2.488 including .535 cross-device sync. body.text: R23 C3 independent exact64 shows five late thumb excursions at 1.62–1.79 s, two DIP high while held against support and three PIP low around withdrawal. Saturated targets near those limits distinguish these cases from the [redacted] MCP2 pregrasp issue. On a selected nominal exact 16 containing all five plus eight safe carry and three safe noncarry scenes, a .03 rad thumb PIP lower and DIP upper target margin preserved 16/11/11 stages and removed all five excursions. At the separate .005 rad stop-compliance bracket, matched original/.03/.06/.10 margins show 8/7/10/9 travel episodes and 9/12/12/13 carries, with no stops. Uniformly larger thumb margins do not show consistent safety improvement. The .03 candidate has the same actor weights and a fixed target envelope, validates p99 .29 ms, and now runs the unchanged frozen 64-start model. No envelope is in R24. Files work/r23_thumb_target_cap_005_comparison.json, work/r23_c3_thumb_target_nominal003/0/results.json, work/r23_c3_thumb_envelope_003_validate.log.

The fixed .03 rad thumb target envelope from r0331 gives 64 lifts, 51 verified turns and carries, zero places, zero stops and 13 final robot rests under the original exact 64-start evaluator. Six different trials have travel violations versus one for the base on these same starts. One new trial has arm travel, wrist coupling and digit excursions together. This broader result reverses the favorable enriched 16-start safety signal. Neither variant nor its bounds are kept or gated. Evidence work/r23_c3_thumb_envelope_003_fixed/scored.json. R24 uses the original bounds.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. After qualifying held support, charge up to .075 points per 100 Hz sample when the plug is held off the table. The charge rises linearly from zero at 12 mm above standing height to its maximum at 37 mm, capped at 3 points per episode. Charging ends after .10 s of continuous hand separation.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.text: Table stops after sustained separation. Replayed all six exact recorded table stops from R24 C1/C2 with the same sent targets. An offline positive-change penalty in a 25 mm reserve above the hard 10 mm margin, gated after 0.12 s of continuous detachment following an unsupported hold, charges all six before the stop. At .20 weight and cap 4, median .486 points using min(commanded, measured) versus .241 measured-only. Seven feasible complete references carry zero charge. Among sixteen other nonstopping safe carriers, one has .012 charge and the median is zero. Table-only recomputation agrees with the public clearance routine at 32 validation poses. This identifies a promising separate safety reward and supplies no candidate action. Evidence work/r24_table_reserve_prospective_exact.json.

R25 will test the partial-open curriculum from r0335. Use R23 C3 r0325 and its saved Adam so the only training-method change from that parent setup is appending the 19 physically validated partially opened, still-held starts and cached sensor history. R24 has no exact quiet supported release through four checkpoints. Its C3 lower reward charge did not lower held peak rise, and its late arm stops worsened relative to the selected parent. Return to the parent objective for this comparison. Preserve .70 full starts, .32 guided phase-5 weight, matching PPO parameters, all four L40S at 8192 worlds/device, every-update timing, unchanged v3 interface and frozen evaluator. New report-only reset-bank row logs distinguish the added 19 sources from prior phase-5 starts. R0259 montages 1019263533 and 1122658388 reviewed before the change show a held plug at .46 s and separation on the table at 4.38 s with continuing hand motion. Expect the learned actor to retain support through opening, tested both on withheld partial suffixes and exact full starts.

Prospective asymmetric PPO value head. Keep the actor trunk and 26 means on their original contract features. Add 28 normalized training-only columns to the shared scalar value head for reward phase, true plug pose and velocity, hand and table contacts, seated latch, accrued active turn and quiet-release samples. The value fit can distinguish held support and attachment from off-table relift when they give similar delayed observations. Zero-padding the critic weight and Adam state exactly preserves both the parent actor and its initial value on the test inputs. A PPO update changes the new value columns, and changing those columns leaves actor outputs identical. Exported arrays match the parent exactly, with local contract p99 .254 ms. This is a feature and optimizer check. R25 is symmetric and the change has no training result yet. Evidence work/asymmetric_critic_unit_checks.json. Primary method references https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.06542 and https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.00177.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. After qualifying held support, charge up to .075 points per 100 Hz sample when the plug is held off the table. The charge rises linearly from zero at 12 mm above standing height to its maximum at 37 mm, capped at 3 points per episode. Charging ends after .10 s of continuous hand separation.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: Endpoint 176.94M new interactions over 71 profiled updates. Exact64 gives 64 lifts, 51 turns and carries, no places or successes, six travel trials (two arm and four digits), three table stops, 14 final robot rests and .266 ms contract p99. Stops at 7.78, 8.95 and 9.62 s have two measured and one commanded clearance below 10 mm. Forty-nine held supports in goal, 28 upright, 24 four-tick controlled inside the initial upright hold, nine strict quiet samples, three brief supported gaps, 25 relifts and zero sustained supported releases. Medians .739/.312/.0127 m/s and +51.47 mm target y after touchdown. Across 30 paired controlled holds, held rise changes -5.39 mm (95% [-17.87,+2.85]) while cumulative charge changes -.510 (95% [-.784,-.231]). Prepared50 gives one transient half-second quiet release, no final object release, seven robot rests and two traveled trials, zero stops or full suffix. Stochastic terminal object proxy 169/182374 full and 1914/20424 phase-5 includes no robot rest check. Production all-four rate 112486 inclusive and 115137 warm. Per-rank medians physics 9.019 s, controller 2.190, sensor .734, inference .144, resets 2.096, ramp .548 and optimizer 2.534 including .595 synchronization. Thirty-three completed sampled audits are clean with zero capacity errors. This objective is set aside for the partial-opening comparison with the original parent and frozen evaluator.

body.text: Exact seated-force diagnostic following the weak penetration signal r0296. Match 50 held supports in nominal and delayed dynamics across fixed hold, gradual opening, quick opening and held relift. A reduction of at least 25% summed hand normal load for four controller samples during slow upright loaded support occurs in 3/50,50/50,10/50,0/50 nominal and 8/50,49/50,10/50,0/50 delayed. Median max transient reductions for gradual are .804/.812 and for hold .187/.185. No hardware events or stops in these controlled rollouts. Such force is a training-side measurement, and contact force on the station remains unmeasured. A candidate reward needs an explicit causal opening or gating control to eliminate the eleven fixed-hold cases and a matched Warp check. Evidence work/release_force_effect_exact.json. No change in R25.

Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact

reward_terms.name: bonus

body.reflection: At 106.71M new interactions, exact64 gives 64 lifts, 54 turns and carries, zero places or success, three hardware travel trials (two digits and one late arm), zero stops, nine robot rests and .257 ms p99. All 54 carriers first reach held support in goal, 46 upright, 42 four-tick controlled inside the initial upright hold, eight strict quiet held samples, 43 relifts and five initial brief upright supported gaps. Stochastic object-only terminal proxy 91/110892 full, 121/1948 added partial and 737/8506 other phase-5. These omit final robot rest. All four GPU timings and the exact CPU evaluator are in this record.

body.reflection: At 141.98M new interactions, the fixed exact station set and independent 64 starts each give 64 lifts, 53 turns and 52 carries, with no places or successes. Each set has one digit excursion and zero stops or arm violations. Fixed seed 60116 has thumb PIP -.32455 rad at 1.83 s while held unsupported, with -.30 target. Independent seed 467374651 has .02146 rad excursion and there are no independent early digit excursions. Final robot rests 13 fixed and seven independent. Fixed p99 contract act time .265 ms. All 52 low carriers get held support in zone, 37 upright, 35 controlled four ticks, seven strict quiet samples, 36 relifts and zero supported releases. Median .693/.323/.0202 m/s and +51.48 mm palm target y after touch. Thirty-two matched controlled holds reduce peak off-table rise median 37.53 mm (95% [-49.08,-27.00]), with no sustained release. Independent partial11 gives zero half-second or final object releases, three robot rests and zero faults/stops. C3 separately completed two prepared suffixes on two partial-opening variants of the same scene seed. Four GPUs profiled, exact evaluation fixed. The broad carry advance motivates a fresh dev gate while maintaining the existing safety rule.

body.text: R25 C3 on the 19 partial opening training-source starts gives four quiet releases, three final object releases, five robot rests, one travel case, no stops and two complete diagnostic suffixes. The completions are two prepared variants of the same scene seed 882966872, rows 0 and 11, with first quiet at .46/.30 s, final palm range 1.61/1.98 mm and finger range .00828/.01175 rad, no travel or stop. Its R23 C3 parent gives zero complete suffixes over this bank. R25 C3 still gives zero complete suffixes on disjoint partial11 and retimed12 and zero placements from full starts. Evidence work/r25_c3_prepared_partial19_exact.json. The prepared variants contribute localized learning evidence.

Matched Warp grip-load evidence r0344. Under the same physical 50 held starts and nominal/delayed dynamics, require both change in digit targets over .02 rad and a sustained .25 load drop over four controller ticks while held upright on loaded table support. The resulting matches are 0/48/9/0 fixed/gradual/quick/relift nominal and 0/49/11/0 delayed. Unguarded fixed targets would give 3/50 and 4/50. All 400 controls have zero hardware violations, stops or capacity errors. The observer uses simulated solver normal load and is a potential training reward only. Evidence work/release_force_effect_warp.json.

Matched lateral forecast integration r0347 on 34 physical carry starts each has old stage transitions and bonus unchanged. The .18 s projected-y cost has medians zero for fixed and gentle, .09464 quick, zero random. It charges 0/7/25/0 of 34 cases, with max .139 for gentle and 1.339 quick. The pure accumulated cost, paid carry difference and training integration agree. All 136 controls have zero travels, stops and capacity problems. Tensor checks cover phase, velocity direction, airborne held contact, first support latch, cap and reset. Evidence work/prospective_lateral_braking_warp.json and work/lateral_braking_tensor_checks.json.

R26 tests lateral braking alone from R25 C4 r0349 with matched Adam and the same 457 prepared physical states, phase probabilities, fixed .35 exploration, .000044 LR, 8192 worlds per device, all four L40S and exact evaluation. R25 improved held support and reduced peak rebound, yet its measured y target advances about 51.5 mm during the first .14 s after contact. R0347 and r0352 support testing earlier y braking to reduce that advance and sustain upright supported separation. The optional term charges projected overrun before first held contact, while others remain identical. Gate jad9 is independently evaluating the R25 parent after the r0259 montage review at 07:49. The load observer and asymmetric critic remain separate prospective variants.

On the same 19 partially open trained-source states for R25 C3, nominal Warp mean actions give 4/19 half-second releases, zero final object releases and two robot rests. Two sampled .35 replicas give 7/38 half-second releases, one final object release and zero robot rests. Neither gives combined final rest. Travel 0/2, stops 0/0 and no capacity problems. Exact CPU mean has 4/19 quiet and 2/19 combined suffixes from variants of one scene. The early quiet rate does not distinguish mean from sampled in this collection. Final outcomes also remain sensitive to dynamics and sensor realization. Evidence work/r25_c3_prepared_partial19_warp_noise.json and work/r25_c3_prepared_partial19_exact.json.

R25 C4 start geometry and matched contact diagnostic. All 64 bare hull traces keep at least 1.739 mm middle–ring distance through first opposition. Forty-three later overlaps by .45 s peak at 3.505 mm. Sixteen paired nominal scenes give 16 lifts, 13 turns and carries with zero travels/stops. The separate added-pair model with .1075 s delay and .010 rad compliance gives 16/8/7, ten later digit excursions, zero early breaches, zero arms/stops, first .45 s ring maximum .01676 rad. This is test-bracket sensitivity. Station contact and stop compliance remain unconfirmed for the revised start. Evidence work/finger_contact/r25_c4_exact_geometry.json and work/r25_c4_contact_bracket_exact.json.

Across 41 paired first supports relative to R25 C4, median first-touch y moves -4.33 mm (95% [-7.13,-.37]), mean lateral speed before touch changes -.0222 m/s (95% [-.0399,-.00036]), forecast cost -.122 (95% [-.173,+.007]) and touchdown lateral speed is unchanged within uncertainty. body.text: r0358 rejected R25 C4 on seven hardware-violating trials to zero across 96 fresh pairs. Candidate versus incumbent lift 96/96, turn 82/64, carry 81/42 and place 0/0, with no stops. Carry gain/loss 43/4 (one-sided p=1.4e-9). Six flags are measured digit excursions .02013–.02450 rad and one is arm travel. Four violating trials complete carry. Reviewed the gate montages at 07:54. In seeds 1020909259 and 558929653 the plug is acquired by the .46 s frame and separated at 4.38 s. The first ends near upright with the hand moving nearby. The second is on its side with continued arm and finger motion. The gate holds the original incumbent. R26 is testing the paired precontact heading correction from r0353. Diagnose fault timing on separate nominal replays using independent sensor seeds before selecting another safety change.

Independent-sensor replay of the seven r0358 fault scenes, six draws per scene, gives one digit event and no arm events across 42 exact trials. Seed 495056309 reaches ring PIP 1.42236 rad at 1.43 s under target 1.40 while the plug is held and table-supported. The gate uses a separate sensor salt, so this establishes one reachable fault mechanism in one scene and does not identify the seven original event timings. It is later and at a different joint than the [redacted] pregrasp MCP2 contact. The fresh gate reliability gain remains blocked by contact-sensitive digit travel. A graded .005 rad excursion onset in exact trace rescoring adds prior cost in all five observed local R25/R26 digit cases, with healthy medians .013–.016 and max .00017 in seven feasible completions, yet it also charges most healthy learner episodes. Treat it as soft guidance, not a violation classifier. Evidence work/r0358_travel_diagnostics/diagnostics.json and work/prospective_digit_travel_cost_exact.json.

body.text: The partial-opening training bank has 19 rows from just five distinct scenes. Both R25 C3 complete prepared suffixes came from the same scene. Test whether the physical reset construction can cover more of the true deployment distribution. Use 192 new scene seeds disjoint from the existing curriculum, fixed checks, independent checks and known gate seeds. Replay R25 C4 through the exact deployment prefix and use the existing retimed physical seating controls to propose states. Validate each restored pose and cached sensor history independently before considering training. The 6-second diagnostic prefix is for capture only. Preserve the fixed and withheld assessment sets. No controller action becomes a training target.

In the matched Warp load observer r0351, guarded gradual unloading is available a median .15 s before first hand separation in both dynamics brackets, with ranges .05–.24 s nominal and .07–.29 s delayed. Guarded quick opening has median .10 s. This provides several policy samples of feedback while support still exists. The optional training term records a measured baseline over four controlled ticks, tests target motion only on baseline-contacting digits, requires a continuous four-tick reduction and pays at most two points once. Tensor checks verify baseline continuity, real load reduction, hold, unused digits, active award and reset. Full integrated physical controls are queued after R26. This does not supply actor observations. work/grip_unloading_tensor_checks.json and work/release_force_effect_warp.json.

body.text: R27 tests supported grip unloading alone from R25 C4 r0349 and its matching Adam. In the frozen jad9 gate r0358 montages, both plugs are among the fingers at 0.46 s and separated by 4.38 s; 1020909259 tends upright while the hand returns, and 558929653 lies on its side. R26 C1-C4 produce many held in-zone supports but no sustained supported releases. Their smaller first-touch y does not resolve relift or opening. The integrated paired 400-world Warp control pays one two-point force-transfer milestone in 20 and 18 of 50 gradual releases and 15 and 13 of 50 quick releases in nominal and delayed/soft brackets. Zero of 200 fixed grips and relifts pay. Both reward variants give identical phase and goal histories at the end, and the observed release-term difference equals exactly two per paid world. All 400 are clean of travels, stops and capacity overflow. The earlier independent signal probe r0351 measured .15 s median lead for gradual opening. Reward requires supported, upright, quiet load transfer and a command change on an involved digit. It does not pay for the command itself. See work/grip_unloading_reward_integration_warp.json. Expect more controlled seated progress before separation and more supported releases after ~150M active steps, with the same exact evaluator, 457 reset states, four GPUs, sampling, PPO, start pose and data distribution. The R26 fifth actor remains valid for exact scoring but its matching optimizer was overwritten just before endpoint. Future trainer exports preserve named snapshots before announcing packages.

body.reflection: At 176.94M new interactions the frozen exact evaluator reaches the first policy completion from the deployment start. The 64 fixed starts give 64 lifts, 51 turns, 51 carries, one ordered placement and success, one travel violation in another trial, zero stops, 14 final robot rests and .299 ms contract p99. Seed 106472 touches support held at 1.39 s and 15.69 deg, then reaches an upright held seat at 1.46 s. It separates at 1.61 s with .61 deg tilt and a brief support gap. It remains quiet and untouched from 1.83 to 22.80 s and from 23.17 through the end after recontact. Final body centre [.48640,.10950,-.29354] m. Final finger range .0411 rad and palm range 4.7 mm. The seat arrives after first contact, so the initial-upright-only subset omits this completion. Among 33 initial upright contacts, 28 reach four controlled ticks, ten have a strict quiet held sample, 26 relift, seven have a brief supported gap and none has sustained supported separation. Paired against R25 C4 on 43 first supports, y at touchdown falls 5.94 mm (bootstrap 95% [-7.54,-2.23]), forecast charge falls .161 points and touch lateral speed rises .0614 m/s. Evaluation uses the exact station and independent confirmation is running. The actor package validates, and the ongoing trainer overwrote its matching Adam before the snapshot could be preserved. Source logs and video document local performance, with no official gate claim.

body.reflection: Endpoint at 179.299M yields exact64 64 lifts, 49 turns and carries, zero places or successes, two travel trials and no stops, 12 robot rests and .265 ms contract p99. The prior checkpoint's successful scene 106472 now has an arm joint 4 excursion at 13.12 s. Seed 967882 has arm joint 6 travel at 18.75 s and pinky DIP .02197 rad past its lower limit at 27.77 s after separation. Both are distinct from the [redacted] early middle–ring contact mechanism. Twenty-eight first held supports are upright, 23 reach four controlled ticks, 12 have a strict quiet held sample, 22 relift and six have brief supported gaps. `None` has sustained separation while supported. Median speeds .716/.293/.0146 m/s with +51.64 mm sent y after touchdown. Against R25 C4 on 42 matched supports, first touchdown y falls 5.24 mm (95% [-8.54,-1.94]) and forecast charge .140 points, while touch lateral speed rises .0739 m/s. R26 C5 independent 64 starts give 64/50/50/0, two ring PIP travels near the travel allowance, both after 1.39 s, no stops and 17 rests. The only full completion so far is the C5 fixed-start case. The full R26 run used the four L40S across 72 updates at 114,312 active steps/s inclusive and 117,649 warm. Per-rank physics 9.064 s, controller 2.180, sensor .739, actor .144, reset 2.021, ramp .524 and optimisation 2.521 including .531 sync. No capacity overflow and 31 complete sampled contract checks without problems. The exact evaluator remains frozen.
