body.text: R26 continuation produced the first learned full deployment completion in r0368, one of 64 fixed starts. Seed 106472 is held with 15.69 deg tilt at contact 1.39 s, upright and held at 1.46 s, separates at 1.61 s during a brief support gap, then stands untouched and quiet from 1.83 to 22.80 s. It stands quiet again from 23.17 to 30 s after recontact, final x/y/z [.48640,.10950,-.29354] m, finger .0411 rad, palm 4.7 mm. The right-view contact sheet and numeric trace agree. Its fixed safety failure, a separate J2 at 21.29 s, is after last contact 2.09 s. On independent 64 it carries 50 but places none, with two ring PIP faults .02185/.02001 rad at 1.40/2.14 s, zero stops. On 12 fresh sensor histories for the successful scene it completes zero and has zero travel/stops. The fault scene yields one travel on 12 fresh histories. The endpoint r0369 gives zero complete and a joint-4 travel on the earlier success scene. No C5 gate is selected at this time. Forecast braking repeatedly reduces first touch lateral position 1–6 mm yet later sent y remains about +51 mm in .14 s, and relift generally persists. See work/r26_c5_learned_completion_matched_exact.json, work/r26_c5_noise_diagnostic/diagnostics.json and work/r26_late_exact_travel_breakdown.json.

Post-support action comparison from 28 R26 C5 exact controlled-contact prefixes. The same fixed controls from the next policy tick after the first four controlled upright held support samples give 0/28 quiet half-second releases as recorded, 14/28 with wrist braking alone, 0/28 with gentler finger opening alone, 6/28 with both, and 25/28 with both then upward withdrawal. At the 4 s diagnostic horizon, ordered physical placement plus object and robot rest occurs 0/0/0/6/15 respectively. All lift/turn/carry histories stay present. One brake-only and two each combined traces have travel violations and are excluded from completions. There are no stops. Median held height overshoot is 62.1/34.5/63.3/31.2/31.2 mm. This controls for the same deployment prefix and is separate from the learned actor and frozen 30 s suite. Run matched 30 s replays to test whether the gain survives and diagnose how to teach the wrist to stop moving the object during transfer, while the R27 grip-only reward comparison continues. See work/r26_c5_seat_actuation_exact_4s.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. Add a single two-point milestone for grip unloading on a controlled seat. Acquire baseline hand normal load over four loaded table-support ticks while held upright, with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. Then require four continuous support ticks with speed at most .05 m/s, spin at most 1.5 rad/s, and hand normal load at most 75% of its baseline of at least 1 N. Targets on digits that contacted the plug during the baseline must jointly move by over .02 rad. The plug remains held and table normal load stays above .10 N. Breaking support resets an unearned baseline.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: At 36.131M new active interactions the exact station gives 64 lifts, 49 turns, 48 carries, zero placement or success, one travel, zero stops, ten final robot rests and .262 ms contract p99. All 48 carriers reach held support in the goal, 37 at first upright touchdown, 35 for at least four controlled ticks and ten with a strict quiet held sample. Thirty-five relift and three have a brief supported gap; none separates while supported for a sustained interval or achieves a half-second quiet release after that first upright held contact. Precontact/touch/quietest held median translation speeds .703/.324/.0183 m/s and wrist target +51.61 mm y in .14 s after touchdown. In the 36 common controlled starts, median held peak rise changes -1.65 mm (bootstrap 95% [-13.40,+4.74]), and relift integral +.109 points with an interval crossing zero. Held-out prepared partial11 has zero releases, two final hand rests and no travel or stops. This is the first isolated grip-unloading checkpoint, standard exact frozen scorer and start. Traces, profiles and curves record all four GPUs.

body.text: Matched full 30 s nominal station controls after four consecutive upright held support ticks reproduce the earlier physical diagnosis. Among 28 R26 C5 deployment prefixes, recorded commands give 0 complete, a smooth wrist hold plus gradual finger opening gives 21 complete, and adding 65 mm upward withdrawal after opening gives 23 complete. At least one .50 s quiet object interval occurs in 0/22/25. All branches retain 28 verified carries. Travels 1/2/2, stops 0/0/0. The arm action switches to holding measured pose over .20 s. Open fingers start .12 s after the switch and interpolate over .66 s. Neither comparison enters PPO as action examples. Plain true object planar velocity and projected footprint costs in the first .35 s did not distinguish the successful control from the original, despite the latter having about twice the median peak held rise. Delayed wrist actuation may hide the difference early. Compare a short forward projection under the commanded wrist lead before choosing another reward. Work/r26_c5_seat_actuation_exact_30s.json and work/r26_c5_seat_actuation_effects_exact_4s.json.

body.reflection: At 106.657M active steps exact64 gives 64 lifts, 50 turns and carries, zero ordered placements and successes, one travel, zero stops, 18 final robot rests and .263 ms contract p99. Thirty-nine first held contacts are upright and in zone, 31 have four controlled ticks, eight have a strict quiet held sample, 32 relift, seven show a brief supported gap, and none has sustained supported release or a subsequent .50 s quiet interval. Median translation speeds .728/.300/.0175 m/s and +51.59 mm wrist target y after touchdown. In 40 paired controlled supports, peak held rise is 6.77 mm higher than R25 C4 (bootstrap 95% [.40,14.21]). The 26-minute run stopped at an asynchronous CUDA index assertion during update 48. The latest valid weights and Adam are this C3 checkpoint. Forty-seven completed updates and 116.93M active steps measure 111,188 active steps/s inclusive and 114,643 warm over all four L40S. Median physics 8.740 s, controller 2.185, sensor .746, inference .146, resets 1.948, ramp .492, optimization 2.587 including .629 sync. Prior completed updates report zero capacity overflow and 18 clean complete sampled contract audits. The evaluator remained exact and unchanged.

body.text: R28 separately tests a bounded post-seat wrist-target forecast charge from R25 C4 r0349 and its archived Adam. Keep the same 457 reset states, seed, four GPUs and exact scorer, with the grip-loader and pre-contact lateral charge disabled. In the latest jad9 gate montages r0358 both plugs are among the fingertips at .46 s and separated by 4.38 s. First tends upright while the hand returns, second lies on its side. The r0373 physical controls from 28 original learned deployment prefixes held the wrist near its measured pose, opened and completed 21 placements, or 23 with withdrawal, over the full 30 s. A forecast of object translation using wrist target minus measured wrist gives median .357 points on original commands and zero with wrist braking, a lower charge on all 28 pairs. Finger-only opening scarcely changes it. Warp paired integration gives zero charge in held, gentle or fast opening, random and slow relift controls, and positive charge in 10/19 lateral pulls in each dynamics bracket. Other terms and stage goals agree for identical commands. Random commands cause existing hardware and stop events, and lateral pulls cause two stops per bracket. Exact forward kinematics and the palm body origin differed at most 8.4 micrometres over 128 poses. R28 charges .20/tick for at most 35 ticks after a four-tick controlled seat, only while held, at most 4 points. Forecast distance allowance is 5 mm outside the footprint or 22 mm above standing. Expect smaller target travel in the first .14 s and more well-supported quiet releases over ~150M active steps. R27 ended on an asynchronous CUDA index assertion in update 48, first surfaced in reward tracking. Forty-seven finished updates, three validated checkpoints and all prior capacity checks are preserved. Exact cause remains unconfirmed. Work/r28_target_forecast_integration_warp.json and work/r26_c5_seat_actuation_command_forecast_exact_4s.json.

Prepared a separately testable curriculum addition of six new physical source scenes from the 192 independently drawn R25 prefixes in r0363. Nine retained partial-open captures each hold through a CPU restore for .20 s in nominal and delayed/soft brackets. A gradual deployment-finger opening with a 6 mm downward wrist adjustment during transfer then withdrawal yields sustained seated separation and final object and robot rest in the same eight of nine scenes in both brackets, with no travel or stops. Pure fixed grip releases zero. Paired Warp quiet restore retains eight nominal and seven delayed, zero faults or stops. Six pass both Warp conditions and both CPU opening controls. The recorded invalid sensor histories import in all nine, ages 2.67–3.63 s. The six are disjoint from fixed and independent evaluation sets and the old bank. The optional merged bank appends them to the existing 457 rows and matching cache without changes to the old entries, adding 0.54% of total reset draws with current phase weights. This is prepared only and is absent from R28. Evidence work/r25_diverse_release_partial_physical_sustained.json, work/r25_diverse_partial9_warp_nominal.json, work/r25_diverse_partial9_warp_delayed.json and work/training_reset_pool_diverse_partial_release_check.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. For 35 controller ticks from the first controlled held seat, estimate the plug position if it follows the commanded wrist translation from the measured wrist. Take the larger of the planar distance more than 5 mm outside the goal, and the positive height excess over 22 mm above standing height. For each tick still holding the plug, charge .20 times this excess divided by 35 mm and clipped to [0,1], capped at 4 points total.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: At 36.116M active steps the frozen exact evaluator gives 64 lifts, 52 turns and carries, no placements or successes, three travel trials, zero stops, 11 final hand rests and .257 ms contract p99. Travel comes from two joint-2 events after last plug contact at 4.91 and 9.26 s, and thumb DIP .02152 rad past the upper limit at 1.63 s while held off the table. Of 39 first upright held supports, 35 reach four controlled samples, five briefly reach strict quiet, 36 relift and three show a brief supported gap; no sustained supported release. Median linear speeds .706/.345/.0175 m/s and +51.70 mm sent y over .14 s after initial support. An exact proxy for the trained forecast over 35 ticks after first controlled support finds 45 cases. Across 35 paired R25 C4 comparisons the predicted cost decreases .303 points (bootstrap 95% [-.934,-.198]), height projection -4.18 mm, planar edge projection -10.83 mm, and actual held peak in that window -1.58 mm. Target y change from the later controlled support increases 3.15 mm, and z change is uncertain. Separate relift measurement on 41 cases gives +2.14 mm peak with 95% crossing zero. On held-out partial11 one quiet half-second release did not persist. Four hand rests, zero travel or stops. Exact evaluations use the frozen station. Measured training curves and profiles span all four GPUs.

body.text: R28 C1 prepared holdout seed 802065154 first releases the upright plug quietly at 3.40 s and completes the half-second window at 3.90 s. Original actions recontact at 5.12 s and leave it outside the goal at y=.15121 m, while the hand finishes within both rest thresholds. Matched exact replay after 3.90 s with a smooth measured-wrist hold or upward withdrawal avoids all recontact and ends with object and robot rest at y=.11290 m in both controls. No travel or stops in any branch. Selecting a response to preserve quiet placement is a separate learning issue once a policy separates reliably. Two late exact J2 excursions on other C1 full starts are separately reproduced and removed by three physical post-detachment controls. All interventions are diagnostic. Work/r28_c1_independent_partial_quiet_hold_controls.json and work/r28_c1_late_arm_replays_exact.json.

In the separate paired 16-start arm-delay/contact diagnostic, 16 lift and ten turn/carry with 16 later digit excursions and one arm or coupling excursion, zero stops or early digit faults. body.text: R28 C2 later digit excursions on the 16 matched sensor streams are 0 nominal, 13 with longer arm delay and softer stops, and 16 with the same altered dynamics and middle–ring contacts. Zero digit trips through .45 s in all three. Peak early ring MCP2 excess .00948/.01992/.01906 rad. The first digit trips with contact are at 1.58–2.18 s in thumb joints, ring PIP or middle PIP. On independent nominal starts, the two thumb PIP faults target -.30 rad and the preceding measured sample is around -.21 or -.23 rad with velocity near -14 rad/s. A measured-excess-only cost gives neither useful immediate credit. A .010 s joint forecast when the sent target is within .025 rad of that bound produces a preceding payment for both and a recent payment in 12 of 16 contact-bracket faults, with modest initial cost on successful controls. The forecast also flags the same thumbs in 58/64 fixed and 57/62 non-faulting independent traces in the same .21 s window. It is a margin objective for a common abrupt stop approach. Median uncapped healthy total is around 1.6 points, the seven complete feasibility rows pay zero, and the one learned completion would pay 1.43. Matched Warp integration on 19 prepared starts in each dynamics bracket pays zero in fixed and both opening controls and positive in 17/19 and 19/19 random controls. Only the intended regularity term differs, and the same measured actions give the same phases and goal outcomes. Evidence work/r28_digit_motion_forecast_prospective_exact.json, work/r28_c2_contact_and_delay_exact.json and work/r29_digit_travel_integration_warp.json. Keep the actual 0.020 rad gate allowance, frozen model and safely inward startup pose.

body.reflection: At 106.518M active interactions frozen exact64 gives 64 lifts, 48 turns and carries, zero places or successes, five travel violations, zero stops, 14 final rests and .255 ms contract p99. Forty first held contacts are upright, 33 reach four controlled ticks, six strict quiet, 33 relift and nine show brief supported gaps, with no sustained supported release or half-second quiet interval. Median translation speeds .725/.336/.0185 m/s and sent y +51.62 mm in the first .14 s after upright contact. Across 32 common controlled supports vs R25 C4, 35-tick forecast cost falls .664 points (95% [-1.087,-.323]), peak actual held height in this window falls 3.11 mm, and +3.06 mm more y is commanded in the first .14 s after control. Later relift charge rises .298 points in a separate paired set, actual held rise difference uncertain. Held-out partial11 has no quiet or final object release, one hand rest, zero travel and no stop. Measured curves and profiles record all four L40S. This candidate is not selected for gate.

body.text: R29 will isolate the digit travel forecast from R25 C4 r0349 and matching Adam once R28 ends. Latest gate montage jad9 r0358 has both plugs held at .46 s and separated by 4.38 s. Seed 1020909259 ends mostly upright with the hand returning, and 558929653 lies sideways. The dev gate counted six digit excursions and one arm travel. R28 C2 fixed 64 was clean but independent had two abrupt thumb PIP crossings and a late J2 excursion. R38 C1-C4 shift the forecast objective but have no complete deployment placements. The r0381 controls found earlier credit from projected travel under a target already near a joint bound, with exact paired evidence for a safety margin and zero payment in fixed and physically successful opening controls. Run R29 with digit travel as the only training objective change, .25 per largest outward change and 3 points cap, maintaining the same all-four devices, model, reset distribution, seed and safe -.100 rad middle start. Early stop during actual training and both frozen evaluator travel checks stay the same. Compare roughly 150M active interactions with the parent on independent exact starts and the separate 16-start dynamics comparison. Expect more travel margin at later thumb and ring motion and no loss of carry. Keep only if the fresh gate supports it.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat

body.reflection: Endpoint at 183.862M active interactions yields exact64 64 lifts, 48 turns and carries, zero places and successes, six travel trials (five digits and one arm), zero stops, five final rests and .262 ms p99. Thirty-seven initial upright held supports, 34 controlled, 13 strict quiet, 34 relifts and three brief gaps, zero sustained supported release or half-second quiet. Median speeds .760/.336/.0151 m/s with +51.76 mm sent y in the first .14 s after initial support. In 32 paired controlled supports against R25 C4, forecast charge falls .505 points (95% [-.778,-.237]), sent z increases 2.39 mm and held-height change is uncertain. The separate longer relift integral rises .526 points. Held-out partial11 has zero releases, three robot rests, zero travel or stops. The R28 penalty changes its measured forecast, with no repeatable placement or early wrist brake. R28 achieved 116,471 inclusive and 118,719 warm active steps/s across 74 updates and all four L40S. Rank medians physics 9.235 s, controller 2.184, sensor .686, inference .137, reset 2.035, ramp .534 and optimisation 2.367 including .419 cross-device sync. No capacity overflow, max 165 constraints and 116,597 shared contacts. Thirty complete sampled contract audit streams show one measured joint travel check on rank 3 at 15.89 s in update 41. It ended that training episode. All checkpoint evaluations remain the frozen exact station. No gate selected.

body.text: R38 in r0383 refers to R28. Its six recorded checkpoints end with 183.86M active steps, zero ordered placements and one transient quiet release on a held-out prepared start. The 35-tick in-goal forecast shifts earlier wrist projection by about .23–.66 points over paired checkpoints, but sent y over the first .14 s after initial upright support stays near +51 mm. A relative-lead alternative with 18 mm planar and 22 mm upward allowances gives median 2.327 points on the 28 original diagnostic prefixes versus 1.076 when braking and 1.097 when braking, opening and withdrawing. All 28 paired charges decrease. Fingers-only leaves median 2.339. This alternative is prospective and absent from R29. The guarded force kernel now checks raw contact metadata bounds after the R27 CUDA error. A filtered NVIDIA memcheck timed out after 110 s while reporting potential stream-ordered allocations in the existing Warp narrowphase graph capture. It gives no verdict on the later force kernel. R28 completed normally with force gathering disabled. R27 root cause remains unconfirmed. See work/r29_prospective_relative_wrist_lead_exact.json and work/grip_unloading_guarded_memcheck.log.

A separate retention curriculum can start immediately after a physical release. On 115 of the 192 disjoint R25 deployment prefixes with four controlled upright held support ticks, brake/open/withdraw controls give 101 half-second quiet object intervals and 58 safe placements with object and robot rest at the four-second diagnostic horizon. Thirteen physical trials have travel faults and none stops. No fixed or gate seed is included. Captured starts use actual simulation q, velocity and the sensor estimate after .12 s of continuous untouched quiet support. Fifty-seven pass .20 s holding after nominal and delayed CPU restores, all with their measured invalid pose caches, at 2.28–3.22 s along their source histories. One recaptured contact on CPU restore and was removed. State and cache files work/r25_diverse_post_release_exact_validated.json and work/r25_diverse_post_release_exact_validated_cache.json. Only these physical states and sensor values are potential curriculum data. No physical-control actions enter PPO. Measure paired Warp restore after R29 and separately test whether current saved actors retain rest and avoid renewed contact from these starts before spending another training block.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: At 36.115M active steps exact64 gives 64 lifts, 47 turns, 46 carries, no placements or success, six travel trials (three digit and three arm or coupling), no stops, 18 final rests and .254 ms contract p99. The three first digit excursions are ring MCP2 at 1.49 s with sent +.25 rad, thumb DIP at 1.58 s with sent +1.40 and thumb PIP at 1.74 s with sent -.30. All occurred after .45 s. Early ring MCP2 excursion peak was .01002 rad. The measured finite-difference forecast charges before all three digit trips. Across 64 matches vs R25 C4, predicted cost changes -.049 (bootstrap 95% [-.216,+.112]), measured peak +.00041 rad ([-.00076,+.00255]) and manipulation-window cost -.038 ([-.166,+.111]). The first checkpoint has yet to improve its safety objective. Forty initial held upright supports in the goal include 34 four-tick controlled, ten strict quiet, 35 relifts and five brief supported gaps. No sustained supported releases or .50 s quiet intervals, median speeds .701/.336/.0147 m/s and +51.43 mm y target after first upright support. Exact evaluation and start remain frozen and all four devices are measured in the training profiles.

body.text: The 57 independently prepared post-release starts remain undisturbed and satisfy final object and robot rest for all 57 nominal and all 57 delayed exact CPU trials under fixed restored commands, with zero travel or stops. The prior actors each renew contact in 57/57 with median first contact .13 s, 56/57 and 57/57 by .20 s. R25 C4 produces seven final objects and 12 final robot rests, with no trial satisfying both. R26 C5 gives 12 final objects, 14 final robot rests, and two satisfying both. Neither actor has a fault or stop on these starts. The prepared starts restart observation history and servo state, so the absolute rate is a local reset diagnosis. Matched fixed-command results show the restores themselves preserve the quiet plug. If paired Warp restore agrees, append the eligible detached sources to the original bank as a single curriculum change with current stage weights. For 57 added to the original 100 phase-5 sources, they draw about 3.49% of all resets. Test early renewed contact, final rest and ordered placement separately. Evidence work/r25_diverse_post_release_hold_exact_30s.json and work/r25_r26_post_release_retention_exact.json.

Separate delay and middle-ring contact variant 16/12/12, 11 late digit faults, zero stops or early faults, peak early ring .01450 rad. Different outcomes in that bracket are diagnostic, and the exact evaluation model stays frozen. Four-device training rates and per-update profiles recorded.

body.text: Replaying the actor forward pass on saved observations reproduces every finger command in the first .14 s after initial held goal support. The median raw positive-y latent is 3.09/3.31/3.23/3.06 for R25 C4, R26 C5, R28 C2 and R29 C2. The tanh output exceeds .98 of full lateral rate on median 75/80/80/75 percent of those ticks. The sole learned completion also saturates three of four. Axis-matched exact controls on the 28 R26 C5 prefixes show 9 quiet half-second releases with lateral wrist hold only, one with lateral hold plus opening, zero when braking other wrist axes while keeping y, and zero full four-second placements in all three. Full wrist brake alone gives 14 quiet releases from r0371, and both with withdrawal give 25. The independent y-only/combined y-only controls have zero travel or stops, whereas holding other axes while continuing y has five arm travel cases. This is evidence that several wrist coordinates and finger release must be coordinated, and that the current lateral action often stays saturated despite the forecast reward. No axis control enters PPO. See work/r29_command_latent_after_seat_exact.json and work/r29_lateral_axis_controls_exact_4s.json.

R29 C3 on fixed seed 106472, the same scene as the one R26 learned completion, leaves a quiet released plug from 1.88 to 3.54 s. The first renewed contact is 3.55 s, then index DIP exceeds its lower travel by .02894 rad at 4.76 s while sent target is +.40188. Final plug y=.14038 m and tilt near 90 deg. Exact matched replay keeps all recorded commands until 2.40 s, after the first half-second quiet window. Holding the measured wrist smoothly or holding then withdrawing 65 mm prevents renewed contact. Both finish all ordered exact criteria and normal stage predicates, including object and robot rest with no travel or stop, body [.48336,.11268,-.29354] m. Original recorded commands reproduce the failure. This is a same-scene diagnostic and not another learned success. It identifies an end-of-skill retention failure that a physical reset curriculum can address. See work/r29_c3_full_release_retention_controls.json.

body.reflection: At 106.595M active interactions exact64 gives 64 lifts, 56 turns and carries, zero final places or successes, two travel trials, zero stops, 11 final rests and .509 ms p99. Forty-six first held upright contacts include 38 controlled, 11 strict quiet held, 37 relifts and eight brief supported gaps. There is one released quiet half-second interval, with no sustained separation beginning on the support in this subset. Median speeds .698/.273/.0163 m/s and +51.71 mm y after first contact. Seed 106472 stands quietly from 1.88 to 3.54 s then recontacts at 3.55, later incurs an index DIP excursion .02894 at 4.76 s, and ends sideways outside the goal. This is the same scene as the earlier R26 one-off completion. From the original full-start commands, diagnostic wrist hold and withdrawal beginning at 2.40 s preserve all ordered criteria and both rests with zero travel or stops. Those are controlled replays, not learned outcomes. Paired64 forecast cost -.177 (95% [-.270,-.032]), measured peak and manipulation cost changes uncertain. Independent exact64 64/49/49/0, five travels, no stops and 13 rests. The separate 16-start delayed contact variant has 16/9/9, eight travel trials, zero stops or early digit faults and ring MCP2 peak .01569 rad through .45 s. Corresponding nominal16 16/15/15 and zero faults. Exact evaluator and learned actor remain unchanged by the diagnostics.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.text: R30 will test post-release retention curriculum only, from R29 C3 r0394 and its matching Adam, with the digit travel reward and all other choices fixed. The latest gate montages r0358 show the plug separated by 4.38 s. In the upright scene the hand later returns close to the plug, while the second finishes sideways. The R29 C3 full exact rollout r0393 finishes a 1.66 s quiet release, then returns at 3.55 s, incurs a later index excursion and dislodges the plug. Hold and withdrawal diagnostic controls from the same full prefix preserve both rests and ordered placement. All 57 disjoint detached snapshots kept quiet through .20 s after restoration in both Warp brackets, with zero stops or travel and 57 matched invalid caches at 2.073–3.020 s. All 57 earlier exact CPU fixed controls in both brackets meet final rests through 30 s. Fix the split using seed 318562 before training. Append 42 physical states to the old 457 and reserve 15 distinct sources for independent prepared-state evaluation. New phase-5 rows draw about 2.84% of all resets at existing weights. Exact deployment starts and criteria, next policy interface, model, episode horizon and parameter settings remain the same. Expect less early renewed contact and more combined rest on the held-out 15 after ~150M new steps. Check full deployment placement and travel as well. Work/post_release_curriculum_split.json records the split and digests. No controller commands enter the stored curriculum or PPO loss.

Clarification of r0390. Full 30 s fixed-command replay gives final object and robot rest in every one of 57 nominal and 57 delayed starts, with zero travels or stops. The continuous check finds 54 nominal and 50 delayed objects remain quiet, supported and untouched through every logged tick. The remaining three nominal and seven delayed have brief renewed contact and still meet final rest. All 57 were separately confirmed quiet and detached for the first .20 s on both CPU and Warp. This reduces the scope of the uninterrupted-hold claim. It leaves the r0396 physically validated split and frozen task criteria unchanged. Work/r25_diverse_post_release_hold_exact_throughout_30s.json.

body.reflection: Final 176.858M active interactions (71 updates) gives exact64 64 lifts, 50 turns and carries, zero placements or successes, six travel trials, zero stops, seven final hand rests and .253 ms p99. Four digit and two arm/coupling trials. No early digit trips and peak early ring .01108 rad. The forecast charges all four digits before the measured excursions, but paired cost -.192, measured peak +.00126 rad, and manipulation cost +.020 all have intervals crossing zero against R25 C4. Thirty-four initial upright held supports, 27 controlled, four strict quiet and 27 relifts/seven short supported gaps, with no sustained supported or half-second quiet release. Median speeds .708/.330/.0177 m/s and +51.83 mm y after initial upright touchdown. Four-L40S throughput 113,241 inclusive, 115,611 warm. Per-rank medians physics 9.110 s, controller 2.181, sensor .746, inference .146, reset 2.109, ramp .561 and optimizer 2.595 including .551 sync. Peak 170 constraints / 115,794 shared contact rows, no overflow and zero problems in 30 completed sampled audits. The current source for the separate R30 retention curriculum is the earlier C3, where the one 1.66 s quiet release was lost after renewed contact. No R29 gate or target was selected. All deployment evaluations used the exact station model.

body.reflection: At 36.130M active interactions exact64 gives 64 lifts, 51 turns, 50 carries, zero places or successes, three travel trials (two digits and one arm/coupling), zero stops, 17 rests and .255 ms contract p99. Compared with R29 C3 across 64 paired starts, cost falls .114 points (95% [-.379,-.013]) and manipulation cost .187, while measured peak changes -.00086 rad with interval crossing zero. Thirty-eight initial held supports are upright, 37 continuous four-tick controlled, eight strict quiet held, 37 relift and one brief supported gap. No sustained supported release or quiet half-second release. Medians .717/.242/.0157 m/s and +51.48 mm sent y. On all 15 fixed held-out physical release states, the actor returns to contact with median .14 s, the same as its parent. Each gets ten quiet half-second intervals, three final objects, five final robot rests and one both, on different scene seeds. New candidate zero travel versus one parent and zero stops both. body.text: The current release bonus is paid when a quiet detached window first reaches one-half second. The bonus stays earned if the policy later recontacts the plug. The release progress potential likewise retains its previous maximum, so quiet structure can be lost with no matching loss of release reward. Among 15 detached holdouts, the R29 C3 parent and R30 C1 each have ten quiet half-second intervals but only three final object rests. The same mismatch occurs in a learned full-start rollout in r0393. If adding reset states alone stalls, compare a reversible quiet-release milestone. Give one bounded increment at a validated active quiet release, revoke it after sustained loss and restore it only after another quiet window. It pays nothing for remaining still after earning the milestone, reads only training simulator state and leaves deployment observations, policy, exact evaluation and gauge fixed. Report matched fixed, opening and renewed-contact controls and decide from the full R30 curve before training a version.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

The report includes measured end-to-end four-GPU throughput, per-update timing and appended-state training exposure. Exact station and contract are unchanged. The R31 comparison measures final coupled rest on the same detached starts and exact64 deployment, keeping the frozen evaluator. Evidence work/r31_revocable_release_controls_warp.json.

body.text: R30 C3 detached-state noise controls used the same policy and 15 disjoint physical starts with recorded sensor cache on the exact CPU station. At latent std 0, .025, .067, .35 the trial counts were 15/30/30/30; all recontacted, each group median .13 s. Quiet releases 12/24/21/24, final object rest 4/3/5/3, robot rest 6/4/2/0, simultaneous clean rest 2/0/0/0, no stops or travel. Lower noise aided robot rest counts relative to .35 but did not remove the first recontact of the existing actor or produce combined rest under sampled actions. r0285 already shows noise breaks otherwise safe fixed-command rest. This does not establish what lower exploration would teach. R31 stays matched to R30 at .35 while testing release credit. Evidence work/r30_c3_detached_latent_noise_exact.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R30 checkpoint 05 reached 176.980 million active steps on all four L40S with the same appended curriculum. On the 64 fixed exact station starts it completed 64 lifts, 57 turns, and 57 carries, with zero placements, ten travel violations (three digit, seven arm), zero stops, 14 final robot rests, and .490 ms contract p99. All three finger violations followed early grasping; early ring maximum was .01127 rad. Forty-five first upright held supports, 37 controlled, seven quiet held, 37 relifts, and nine brief supported gaps. `None` had a sustained supported release or quiet half-second after release. Medians .682/.303/.0205 m/s and +51.69 mm sent y lead. The paired digit forecast rose .094 with 95% interval [-.193,.339]. All 15 disjoint detached starts recontacted at median .13 s; 14 later achieved quiet detached support for half a second, but there were zero final object rests, five robot rests and zero simultaneous rests, with no travel or stops. R31 trains from the same parent to test reversible release reward. Evidence work/r30_c5_{touchdown_followup,seating_dynamics_exact,digit_travel_exact,post_release_holdout15_exact}.json.

body.text: Prospective wrist-target lead was repeated on 34 controlled held seats from R30 C3. At the first four eligible controller samples, fixed-command exact replays compare original, wrist braking, finger opening, both and both with a slow withdrawal. Four-second quiet-release counts were 0/21/0/9/28 and safe diagnostic placements 0/0/0/9/23. Median largest held rise was 71/40/69/40/42 mm, with one original, one wrist, zero opening, and one travel in each coordinated mode; no stops. The prospective relative wrist target lead cost uses 18 mm planar and 22 mm upward allowances for 35 controller ticks while held after controlled support. Medians original 2.357, wrist braking 1.382, finger opening 2.389, coordinated 1.371 with or without withdrawal. All 34 wrist-braking costs fall, only three finger-only costs fall. Prior r0387 independently shows the same direction. The earlier absolute footprint forecast was weaker on this sample at a median .391 with a .075 scale and falls on 26/34 finger-only controls. This supports testing relative lead as an isolated alternative if R31 shows no clear improvement in full-start quiet release. Controls use physical command replay, not a learned actor outcome or training targets. Evidence work/r30_c3_prospective_seat_actuation_exact.json. Full-horizon control comparison is running separately.

body.reflection: R30 endpoint used 181.718 million active steps over 73 updates, all four L40S. On the 64 fixed exact station starts it completed 64 lifts, 52 turns and 52 carries, zero placements, three arm travel violations, zero digit violations/stops, ten final robot rests, and .282 ms contract p99. Of 44 first upright held supports, 38 controlled, five quiet held, 37 relifts and seven brief supported gaps, none with a quiet half-second sustained after release. Median approach/contact/minimum seat speed .684/.350/.0228 m/s and wrist target lead +51.69 mm y. Paired digit-cost delta .053 against parent, 95% interval [-.124,.184]. All 15 disjoint detached starts recontacted at median .13 s and again achieved a quiet half-second, but zero finished with object rest and there were four final robot rests, zero combined, and no travel/stops. These appended starts teach local behavior without delivering wider stable terminal retention in this comparison. R31 is a matched reward experiment from the same R29 C3 checkpoint, optimizer and curriculum. R30 full inclusive rate 115,831 and warm 118,226 active steps/s. Per-device median update physics 9.151 s, controller 2.178 s, sensor .696 s, policy inference .138 s, reset 2.047 s plus ramp handoff .538 s, optimizer 2.436 s including .474 s synchronization. No capacity overflow, 30 completed audit traces with no flagged issue. Evidence work/r30_c6_{touchdown_followup,seating_dynamics_exact,digit_travel_exact,post_release_holdout15_exact}.json and work/ppo_gpu_30_post_release_curriculum/full_run_rate.json.

body.text: R30 C3 full 30 s command replays from the same 34 controlled-seat prefixes as r0407 yield 24 safe ordered placements with simultaneous final robot and object rest after braking and opening, and 27 with additional slow withdrawal. There is one travel violation in each mode and no stops. All 34 carry before intervention. Twenty-five and 28 respectively have a quiet half-second. The diagnostic uses identical learned commands to the first controlled support, then physical fixed commands. The held wrist brake improves separation; withdrawal broadens the fixed intervention by three and is not required in every scene. Evidence work/r30_c3_prospective_seat_actuation_exact_30s.json. This is prospective evidence for the relative lead reward, not another learned completion.

The prospective r0407 relative wrist lead reward now has a paired Warp check across 11 prepared partial-release states per mode in both nominal and delayed dynamics. Holding and gentle or fast finger opening charge zero in all 66 controls; both opening methods earn a quiet release in 8/11 per bracket. All 22 lateral shifts and all 22 quick upward pulls while held incur lead costs. Median nominal/delayed lateral .323/.378 and upward .276/.447. The same simulated commands match phases, release milestones and other reward terms exactly. Four delayed lateral and three delayed upward starts have travel violations; fixed hold has three delayed travel flags and opening modes zero. No stops or capacity problems. The quick upward control exceeds the 22 mm active window allowance; the original slow lift does not charge. This is a prospective optional training reward and R31 continues its unchanged study. Evidence work/r32_relative_lead_reward_warp_controls.json.

body.text: Throughput follow-up from the operator note. R30 measured 115831 inclusive and 118226 warm active transitions/s on all four L40S with an actual PPO workload. R31 prefix 16 measured 109301 inclusive and 124200 warm, with median after-two per-rank microseconds per active transition physics 13.518, controller 3.359, sensor 1.190, inference .232, reset 1.743, optimizer 3.972 including synchronization .880. Physics remains the largest part. After R31 finishes, run 16 updates on 12288 versus the existing 8192 worlds/device, matching R31 parent and Adam, seeds, rollout length, minibatch, resets, reward, domain randomization and profiles. Compare active wall rate and normalized timing in all these regions through the first reset wave. Original 8192 C1 exact evaluation overlaps part of its profiled prefix; report concurrent CPU diagnostics when comparing. Timing-only weights stay separate. No station evaluator or gate changes.

Repeat the detachment-observation diagnostic of r0308 on the later R29 C3 and R30 C2/C3/endpoint exact traces, roughly 63–64 scenes per checkpoint. For the largest non-thumb residual, contact-versus-detachment ROC area rises from .545/.616/.587/.696 (difference from current target) to .900/.914/.921/.916 after compensating the encoder and commanded angles for the nominal filter and delay. Only a scored diagnostic uses true contacts. Treat nearby samples within a scene as correlated and use independent sensor/contact checks already in r0308 to assess transfer. The servo residual still has merit as a deployable input in an isolated future run if dynamics-aware reward shaping stalls. No R31 observations change. Evidence work/r30_detachment_encoder_signal_exact.json.

At the first controlled support sample of exact R29 C3, R30 C3 and R31 C1 trajectories, respectively 38/34/30 seats qualify. All cross the optional relative 18 mm planar or 22 mm upward sent-wrist lead threshold; the older absolute projected footprint/height rule crosses on only 2/0/1. Measured median y at that sample is .0636/.0575/.0678 m, with sent y lead +.0327/+.0325/+.0312 m and mean sent z lead still downward about 27–30 mm. The earlier footprint reward sees the translated pose within the goal on nearly all initial controlled supports, even with substantial remaining lateral motion. The alternative would discriminate excess wrist lead at the first eligible controller tick. Exact paired CPU evidence work/relative_lead_first_controlled_exact.json, before any R32 outcome.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry and seat bonuses of 4, 6, 10, 12 and 14. The phase-5 milestone credits 30 points after 15 consecutive active policy samples of quiet detached support in the goal. Three consecutive active samples with a failed release condition debit 30 points. A fresh 15-sample quiet release restores the credit, and holding a credited release pays no repeat bonus.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R31 checkpoint 02 at 71.316 million active steps tests only revocable release milestone credit against matched R30 C2. On the 64 frozen exact station starts it completed 64 lifts, 50 turns, 50 carries and zero placements, with eight travel violations (three digit, five arm), no stops, nine robot rests and .259 ms contract p99. No early digit violations, with early ring maximum .01133 rad. Of 38 first upright held supports, 32 were controlled, eight quiet while held, 30 relifted, and nine had a brief supported gap. `None` produced sustained supported release or a quiet half-second after release. Medians .728/.373/.0181 m/s and +51.84 mm y target lead. Paired digit forecast cost increased .367 with 95% interval [.260,.513] relative to R30 C2. All 15 disjoint detached trials recontacted at median .14 s. Eleven had a later quiet half-second, three finished with object rest, seven with robot rest, and zero with both, without travel violations or stops. The matched R30 C2 had one coupled rest and two full-start travel violations. This checkpoint has not improved full or separate retention. The report includes the four-GPU timing profile and appended-curriculum exposure. Evidence work/r31_c2_{digit_travel_exact,touchdown_followup,seating_dynamics_exact,post_release_holdout15_exact}.json.
