body.text: R31 C2 travel timing on the exact station separates manipulation from motion after separation. Three digit faults occur at 1.56–1.68 s with the plug touching both hand and table: thumb DIP .02029 rad, middle DIP .02061, and pinky MCP2 .02041 below the lower bound with a sent +.25 rad. The five arm faults occur on joints 2, 4 or 6 at 5.87–24.00 s, all after the last plug-hand contact at 2.06–2.15 s. All three endpoint arm faults from R30 also occur after the last contact. The optional 3 degree detached arm charge already pays before all eight events, median 1.248 for R31 and .560 for R30. It also pays 3.668 on the one complete R26 learned success, so the signal is a reserve objective rather than a trip classifier. R31 keeps its isolated setting through the endpoint. Evidence work/r31_c2_travel_timing_exact.json and work/r31_c2_detached_arm_prospective_exact.json.

The detachment observation signal from r0413 remains present in the separate longer-delay and middle–ring collision bracket on R29 C3. On 16 scenes near last contact, with 91 held and 83 detached policy samples, compensating for nominal finger filter and delay increases AUC from .705 to .946 for the thumb residual, .642 to .787 for the largest other digit and .603 to .826 for the second-largest digit. Nearby samples within a scene are correlated. Hardware target data has no measured contact label. This is evidence that a contract-derived encoder residual can help under the diagnostic perturbation. The exact station evaluator and R31 actor are unchanged. Evidence work/r29_c3_detachment_encoder_signal_delayed_contact.json.

reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry and seat bonuses of 4, 6, 10, 12 and 14. The phase-5 milestone credits 30 points after 15 consecutive active policy samples of quiet detached support in the goal. Three consecutive active samples with a failed release condition debit 30 points. A fresh 15-sample quiet release restores the credit, and holding a credited release pays no repeat bonus.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R31 checkpoint 05 at 176.814 million active steps gave 64 lifts, 50 turns, 50 carries and zero placements on exact64. Four arm travel violations, zero digit violations, one arm collision stop and 13 final robot rests. P99 contract time .279 ms. The stop on seed 102609 occurs at 26.91 s on a commanded table clearance of 8.08 mm. Of 43 first upright held supports, 32 were controlled, five quiet held, 33 relifted and 11 had brief supported gaps. Medians .695/.359/.0223 m/s and +51.77 mm y target lead. Paired digit-risk cost -.121 versus R30 C5 with 95% interval [-.275,.006]. Seed 106472 ends safely with the plug upright at [.4871,.0990,-.2935] m and untouched and quiet for approximately 26 s. Palm range 8.7 mm and finger range .0577 rad in the final half-second fail the robot rest criteria. This is the same scene as the previous complete R26 actor rollout, and this C5 case did not meet the task criteria. On all 15 detached diagnostics the plug recontacts at median .14 s, later becomes quiet for half a second, and five finish in object rest, five in robot rest, three in both, with zero travel or stops. The matched R30 C5 had zero object and coupled rests there. Evidence work/r31_c5_{digit_travel_exact,touchdown_followup,seating_dynamics_exact,post_release_holdout15_exact}.json. Independent exact starts and paired follow-up are underway.

body.reflection: R31 endpoint at 179.181 million active steps recorded 64 lifts, 47 turns, 47 carries and zero placements on exact64, with two arm travel violations, zero digit violations or stops, ten final robot rests and .318 ms contract p99. Early ring peak .01145 rad. Of 41 first upright held supports, 39 were controlled, five quiet while held, 39 relifted, and three had brief supported gaps. No sustained supported release or quiet half-second after release. Medians .704/.300/.0206 m/s and +51.78 mm y lead. Paired digit forecast cost delta +.075 against the R30 endpoint, 95% interval [-.095,.318]. All 15 detached starts recontacted at median .14 s and later achieved a quiet half-second. Five object rests, five robot rests and two coupled rests with zero travel/stops. The R30 endpoint produced zero object or coupled rests on those prepared conditions. Revocable release improved some late suffixes but produced no repeated full-start placements. The C5 near-completion came from the same nominal scene that had the sole complete R26 actor rollout. Four GPU profile across 72 updates gives 114,366 inclusive and 117,426 warm active steps/s. Median per rank physics 9.232 s, controller 2.179 s, sensor .700 s, inference .140 s, reset 2.074 s, ramp .557 s and optimizer 2.474 s including .526 s synchronization. No overflow and 30 clean sampled complete contract audits. body.text: The one long quiet placement in R31 C5 fails robot rest and depends on the nominal sensor sequence. Seed106472 is upright untouched from 1.78–3.54 s, recontacts at 3.55 and returns to detached quiet for the last 26.09 s. The original command replay reproduces palm 8.7 mm and fingers .0577 rad in the final half-second. Holding or holding plus withdrawing after the first quiet half-second at 2.30 s prevents renewed contact and yields both rests, all ordered and standard criteria, zero travel or stops in each control. This is diagnostic replay. The saved actor on 12 alternate sensor seeds of the same scene gives zero quiet intervals/placements with one travel and no stops. R31 C5 independent64 gives 64/45/43/0, zero object-rest or quiet half-second cases, six travels, no stops and eight robot rests. Whole R31 improves phase-5 sampled Warp final object proxies from the matched R30 2089/21741 to 2986/21685, but full-start proxies change from 574/192434 to 494/189888. Hardware and task mastery are judged only by the exact evaluator. Evidence work/r31_c5_full_release_rest_controls.json, work/r31_c5_repeat_sensor_histories/report.json, and work/r31_c5_independent_exact/detached_retention.json.

R32 tests only the measured relative wrist lead cost against R30, from the same R29 C3 r0394 and matching Adam. Hold the 499-row curriculum, pose masks, training DR, exploration, network and 8192 worlds on each of four L40S fixed for attribution. The separate 12288/device timing study runs first. Activate .075 per tick on excess 18 mm planar or 22 mm upward sent-wrist position over measured palm during the first 35 controller ticks after controlled held support, only while held and healthy, normalized over 35 mm and clipped. R30 reference and digit travel shaping stay on, revocable reward reserved for another study. r0407/r0409/r0410/r0414 give physical controls and timing. I reopened r0358 gate-20261123T074912Z-jad9 montages for scenes 1020909259 and 558929653. At .46 s both plugs are between the fingers. By 4.38 s both are separated, one sideways. In scene 1020909259 the hand comes close again at 8.34–12.26 s. Exact replay separately shows that early held wrist braking changes later release. Expect lower relative lead during the first 350 ms, fewer held relifts and more sustained releases on matched exact64. Assess detached holdout, hardware, and timing without changing the exact model, contract or evaluator.

Matched four-L40S PPO batch study R31 parent and curriculum, first 16 updates at 8192 vs 12288 worlds/device. Actual end-to-end active rate rises 109301 to 130511 steps/s including startup, and 124200 to 145370 after two updates, about 17% warm. The first full-horizon reset wave at update12 rises 133720 to 158712 steps/s. Median warm per-rank microseconds per active step change physics13.518 to12.286, controller3.359 to2.771, sensor1.190 to.783, policy inference.232 to.150, reset1.743 to1.627, ramp.546 to.462, reward2.293 to1.511, optimizer3.972 to3.856 including cross-GPU .880 to.847. Physics remains largest. Peak shared contacts117341 to175838, max constraints159 to157, no overflows. Six versus four sampled complete contract traces, no flags. CPU exact and diagnostic work overlaps parts of both prefixes; measured real wall rates include that. 12288 is the supported scale for the next adjustable run. Already-started R32 uses four by8192 for the matched reward result. Timing-study weights are excluded and exact evaluator and gates stay fixed. Evidence work/throughput/revocable_batch_matched_comparison.json.

Before the R32 policy results, replay-state scoring of the first controlled 350 ms shows median relative wrist lead charges 2.25–2.33 for the six matched R30 checkpoints, and 2.342 for the R29 parent. Their initial controlled-sample median y lead is 30.1–32.7 mm. Five of seven exact successful feasibility descents had four eligible controlled samples, medians zero charge and +1.56 mm first y lead. The diagnostics are measured on exact controller traces and separate from the trained Warp reward. Compare paired seeds that enter controlled support in both runs. This early lead effect and the reduced number of held relifts are the R32 mechanistic measurements. Evidence work/r32_control_reference_wrist_lead.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. For 35 controller ticks from the first controlled held seat, compare the sent wrist position with the measured palm while still holding the plug. Use the larger excess over 18 mm planar lead or 22 mm upward lead. Charge .075 times its ratio to 35 mm clipped to [0,1] at each active healthy tick.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R32 checkpoint 02 at 71.382 million active steps on all four GPUs gives 64 lifts, 51 turns, 51 carries and zero placements on the 64 unchanged exact station starts. Three digit travels with no early digits, zero arm travels or stops, 12 robot rests and .318 ms contract p99. Early ring peak .01187 rad. Of 38 first upright held contacts, 27 controlled, five quiet while held, 28 relifted and nine had brief supported release gaps. The whole-episode sweep identifies zero quiet half-second releases and zero final object rests. Mean approach/contact/minimum near-seat speed medians .719/.296/.0197 m/s and +51.64 mm y target displacement after support. Among 20 matched controlled seats the 350 ms wrist lead cost delta is -.007 [95% -.046,+.073], and initial y lead delta -5.92 mm [95% -9.30,+5.53]. Both intervals span zero. Paired digit risk +.164 [95% -.099,+.343]. All 15 disjoint detached starts recontact at median .15 s, seven make quiet half-second intervals, five robot rests and zero final object or simultaneous rests, with one travel violation and no stops. The exact train–evaluation comparison still has no full-start release gain. Evidence work/r32_c2_{digit_travel_exact,touchdown_followup,seating_dynamics_exact,relative_wrist_lead_paired,post_release_holdout15_exact,whole_deployment_release_exact}.json.

body.text: The r0427 whole-episode findings isolate two outcomes with exact command replays. R30 C2 seed106472 has final object rest but a 14.7 mm moving palm and recontact at 6.29 s. Wrist hold or hold plus withdrawal from the first quiet half-second at 2.267 s gives both rests, no renewed contact, no faults/stops, and passes the ordered and standard criteria. R30 C5 seed1086461 recontacts at 10.39 s and leaves the goal. Holding or withdrawing after 2.467 s preserves final object and robot rest, no faults/stops and no renewed contact, but the ordered placement still fails. Its carry loses hand contact at 1.38 s when table contact first begins, touches the plug again at 1.39 s, and attains upright held support later. The fixed intervention is after this seat-sequence break. Evidence work/r30_c2_full_release_rest_controls.json and work/r30_c5_full_release_retention_controls.json. These are diagnostic replays.

Revalidated the optional causal finger-tracking residual on the current R29 C3 research parent and its Adam state. Nominal low-pass and delay estimate derives 20 measured minus predicted finger angles from existing hand_q and prev_hand_target observations. Over 320 recorded samples, Torch and packaged NumPy features differ by at most 6.78e-7. Zero padding the first layer and optimizer preserves parent actions within 9.76e-8 and the new columns update. The diagnostic one-network v3 package passes validation with .297 ms p99. This is an observation hypothesis for a later branch, supported by r0413 and r0417, without policy or target changes in R32. Evidence work/r33_hand_tracking_feature_parity.json and work/r33_hand_tracking_contract_probe_validate.log.

body.text: At matched R32 checkpoints 1–3 the wrist lead cost did not fall decisively on starts with a controlled seat in both runs. Paired median deltas -.042/-.007/+.029, intervals all include zero. R32 has more first supported brief gaps, 12/9/12 versus R30 1/4/3, but fewer controlled held seats, 31/27/30 versus 37/41/34. The global release sweeps give zero quiet half-second intervals on all three R32 checkpoints. This pattern indicates a change in how contact breaks around seating without evidence of better stabilization. It does not establish a reward shortcut. Continue R32 to its planned endpoint and look for coherent change before deciding whether to use the relative lead term again. If still flat, the compensated finger-tracking residual has independent support as a different observation hypothesis. Evidence r0426/r0428/r0431.

For the operator throughput follow-up, adopt the separately timed 12288 worlds on each of four L40S and profile all updates. Because scale also changes, report comparisons with 8192 as combined changes, and repeat a matched larger baseline for attribution if the learned branch improves. Keep the same seeds, .35 latent noise, .000044 learning rate, domain randomization and reset weights. The r0358 gate montages reviewed in r0423 show a grip at .46 s, separation by 4.38 s and later renewed approach in seed1020909259. Expect earlier recognition of grip loss, more sustained supported releases and better terminal coupled rest under exact64 and disjoint detached validation. Train for the planned 26 min after R32 exits. The frozen evaluator remains the exact station.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. For 35 controller ticks from the first controlled held seat, compare the sent wrist position with the measured palm while still holding the plug. Use the larger excess over 18 mm planar lead or 22 mm upward lead. Charge .075 times its ratio to 35 mm clipped to [0,1] at each active healthy tick.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R32 endpoint reached 181.641 million active steps in 73 updates on four devices. On exact64 it gives 64 lifts, 48 turns, 48 carries and zero ordered placements. Six travel violations, three digit and three arm, zero stops, 21 final robot rests and .269 ms contract p99. No early digit faults, maximum early ring .01164 rad. Of 39 first upright held supports, 31 controlled, seven quiet held, 32 relifted and seven brief supported gaps. Median approach/contact/minimum seated speed .725/.324/.0167 m/s, and +51.86 mm y target displacement after support. Paired20 lead cost +.017 [95% -.037,+.071] and first y lead -1.35 mm [95% -2.54,+1.07]. Paired digit risk +.001 [95% -.166,+.200]. The full-episode sweep finds one nominal seed, 1086461, that achieves both final rests with no fault or stop, at [.5036,.0999,-.2935] m. It lands at 1.39 s at 16.38 degrees while still held, loses hand contact at 1.40 s before it reaches upright supported, recontacts 1.41 s, and first reaches held upright support at 1.44 s. Hence the ordered stage fails even though the standard placement and rest pass. Quiet first 2.24 to 4.22 s, then last recontact at 4.37 and final quiet. All 15 disjoint detached starts recontact at median .14 s, 14 quiet, three final object and six robot rests and two simultaneous, safe. The wrist penalty shows no consistent reduction in lead or ordered placement gain. Four GPU end-to-end rate 115,854 inclusive/118,198 warm. Median per-rank region seconds physics 9.125, controller 2.177, sensor .693, inference .138, reset 2.085 and ramp .540, optimizer 2.388 including .463 gradient sync. No capacity overflow and 33 sampled completed contract checks with no flags. body.text: A prospective final robot rest reward was measured on exact CPU trajectories. At each policy sample with an entire preceding half-second of quiet detached plug support, compute the larger of measured finger-range/.05 rad and palm-range/.005 m. A .05 per-sample clipped quality proportional to 1 minus half that ratio would pay 3.83 on the sole fully ordered R26 actor success, 5.76 and 6.67 on the R30 and R31 final-object-only scenes, and 12.25 on the R32 standard scene that fails ordered seat. Seven feasibility completions pay 22.75–32.16, and the transient R33 C1 scene zero. A simple accumulated occupancy preference therefore favors some episodes that miss final robot rest. Preserve the graded near-rest signal at lower weight, e.g. .02, and test a distinct clean terminal bonus reflecting both rests when the phase-5 and full horizon conditions are met, e.g. +5. Endpoint ratios .948,2.949,1.745,.579 explain the ranking. R32 also shows the need to keep ordered grip-to-seat checks when comparing. This is prospective and has not entered training. Evidence work/terminal_hold_reward_prospective_exact.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.text: Optional terminal robot rest reward from r0439 is implemented and tested without entering R33. The 51-sample 100 Hz window is reset by any lost quiet contact condition or episode reset. A rank-local tensor test confirms zero before 51, an occupancy gradient for finger and palm motion just above threshold, and +5 only at the clean horizon within both rest limits. In 88 paired Warp controls on 11 prepared starts per mode and bracket, hold/random get zero added credit. Gentle and fast opening each earn graded occupancy on 8/11 in both brackets. At the diagnostic 4 s endpoint, combined-rest bonuses are 8/8 nominal and 5/8 delayed for gentle/fast, matching separate measured final combined rest in every case. All other terms and stage histories agree. The random nominal trial that ends with a quiet object but moving robot receives no credit. No overflow or stops. Evidence work/terminal_robot_rest_tensor_checks.json and work/terminal_robot_rest_warp_controls.json. This small validation briefly overlapped R33 sampling on GPU0 and the run rate includes it. The training option uses the full 900-step horizon.

body.text: R34 tests terminal robot rest from R31 C5 r0420 and matching Adam, the parent that kept a full-start plug quiet through the end and has three safe combined rests in the 15 disjoint detached validation starts. The exact parent full trial exceeded palm and finger rest and the quiet release failed to repeat in r0422. Maintain R31 revocable object-release milestone, digit travel shaping, 499-state bank, .35 noise and all guide/dynamics weights. Add only the new rest measurement to the objective, validated in r0442. Use the independently profiled all-four scale of 12288 worlds per card, so comparison to older 8192 R31 also includes scale and continuation. Current R33 encoder branch strengthens carry but through checkpoint 04 gives no sustained full-start gain, and the feature is absent when resumed from R31. Latest gate r0358 montages reviewed show the plug separating by 4.38 s and the hand approaching the standing plug again at 8.34 s on 1020909259. Exact late replays r0422 and r0429 identify excessive movement as a remaining failure after some quiet releases. Expect more final simultaneous rest on the same detached and full deployment diagnostics, while monitoring upstream order and travel. Train 26 minutes after current R33 completes. Evaluation and gates use the frozen exact station.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.text: First-grip continuity diagnostic on 307 verified carries across R26 C5, R30 C5, R31 C5, R32 endpoint, R33 endpoint and R34 C1. All 307 reached a low upright in-goal region while held. 301 achieved at least one upright supported sample in the same grip after the verified turn. Sixty of these reached upright supported after initial table contact. Six detached before an upright seat in that first grip, including the two 1086461 examples from R30 and R32. Of the 301 linked held seats, 251 subsequently lose table support again within the same grip. This suggests that arresting the held relift and stabilizing detachment remain broader failures than premature grip break. The stats follow the first verified turn, and final ordered placement is still assessed by the exact suite. Evidence work/prospective_seat_link_exact.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. Once the phase-5 plug is quiet, upright, detached and supported in the goal for 51 consecutive 100 Hz samples, compute the larger of maximum finger range divided by .05 rad and palm range divided by .005 m. Credit .02 per active policy sample times one minus half this ratio, clipped to [0,1].

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry and seat bonuses of 4, 6, 10, 12 and 14. The phase-5 milestone credits 30 points after 15 consecutive active policy samples of quiet detached support in the goal. Three consecutive active samples with a failed release condition debit 30 points. A fresh 15-sample quiet release restores the credit, and holding a credited release pays no repeat bonus. Add 5 at the clean episode horizon if the same quiet detached window is present and the measured robot range ratio is below 1.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R34 checkpoint 02 at 73.656 million active transitions on four L40S gives 64 lifts, 49 turns, 48 carries and zero placements under exact64. Five travel trials (three digit and two arm), zero stops, nine robot rests and .259 ms contract p99. No early digit faults, early ring peak .01044 rad. Of 41 first upright supported grips, 30 controlled, five quiet held, 31 relifts and ten brief supported release gaps. Whole-episode review shows zero quiet half-second separations or final object rests. Medians .717/.327/.0197 m/s and +51.77 mm y target displacement. Paired digit forecast cost +.162 [95% -.028,+.280] versus the R31 C5 parent. All 15 detached validation starts recontact after median .14 s and later attain quiet release. Four final object rests, two robot rests, one combined, with no travel or stops. The parent had five object, five robot and three coupled rests. No evidence of a terminal rest improvement at this checkpoint. The samples compare continued training and different occupancy as well as the new reward. Measured per-device regions and wall rates are included. Evidence work/r34_c2_{digit_travel_exact,touchdown_followup,seating_dynamics_exact,whole_deployment_release_exact,post_release_holdout15_exact}.json.

body.text: The previous relift shaping r0336 began charging above 12 mm and capped at 3. Retrospective exact paired controlled-seat replays show a larger excess can distinguish many failed overshoots from successful recoveries. In the R30 C3 source34, 28 original command traces lift the held plug greater than 55 mm above standing height following the first controlled seat. Among 24 safe 30 s brake-and-open placements, four cross 55 mm, and among 27 safe with withdrawal, five cross it. These control groups share starts. In the earlier R26 source28, 21 original trajectories cross 55 mm versus zero of 15 safe short-horizon withdrawal outcomes. A prospective objective could reduce each episode’s new maximum above 45–55 mm after first controlled held support, with geometry-sensitive tolerance. It must preserve the legitimate smaller displacements that occur before release and be judged on untouched exact starts. Evidence work/r30_c3_prospective_seat_actuation_exact_30s.json and work/r29_prospective_relative_wrist_lead_exact.json. R34 is unchanged.

body.text: R0451 follow-up on first uninterrupted grip. Across seven exact cohorts 200/348 linked held seats exceed 55 mm after first upright support. The seven complete feasibility controls and the sole full ordered learned rollout have first-grip peak 1.10–2.43 mm. In the paired R30 C3 34-start command replays, the new formula charges each new held peak above 45 mm, scaling 25 mm to a ten-point cap and ending at first grip loss. Original commands charge all34 with median10. Brake plus opening and brake plus opening plus withdrawal have median0 and reduce cost on 32/34 and 31/34 pairs. Among 24 and 27 safe exact long placements, 8 and 9 respectively pay any cost and none pays the cap. Tensor checks pass. Paired Warp holds and both opening modes cost zero in all 66 nominal/delayed cases, 10/11 upward held lifts trigger in each bracket, medians6.626/6.813 and no safety or capacity issue for those pulls. A random nominal case also incurs a charge. Other terms and phases agree. Evidence work/linked_success_after_seat_headroom_exact.json, work/prospective_first_grip_relift_exact.json, work/first_grip_relift_prospective_cost_exact.json and work/first_grip_relift_warp_controls.json. The small GPU control briefly overlaps R34, whose actual rates include it.

body.text: R35 tests the calibrated first-grip relift reward r0453 from R33 C3 r0441 and its matching Adam. This checkpoint carries on 57/64 exact starts, has 41 first controlled supports and relifts in 41 first upright held cases, with no sustained quiet release. Keep the deployable hand encoder residual, R33 reward for earlier stages, 499 physical reset states, seed, guide weights, sensor masks, .35 noise, .000044 LR and four by12288 world batch. Add the one charge on new airborne held height above 45 mm from first controlled support until grip loss, reaching 10 points at 70 mm. It has zero cost for quiet held and ordinary opening controls. Do not include the terminal-rest experiment from R34. The r0358 montage review shows early holding at .46 s and loose objects by 4.38 s. r0449/r0453 resolve the much earlier supported relift on exact traces and causal command replays. Expect less measured first-grip excess for paired controlled starts, healthy ordered support counts and more quiet releases, then final completion if available. Use the 26 min measured production schedule and frozen exact station. R34 terminal study continues to its planned endpoint first.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. Once the phase-5 plug is quiet, upright, detached and supported in the goal for 51 consecutive 100 Hz samples, compute the larger of maximum finger range divided by .05 rad and palm range divided by .005 m. Credit .02 per active policy sample times one minus half this ratio, clipped to [0,1].

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry and seat bonuses of 4, 6, 10, 12 and 14. The phase-5 milestone credits 30 points after 15 consecutive active policy samples of quiet detached support in the goal. Three consecutive active samples with a failed release condition debit 30 points. A fresh 15-sample quiet release restores the credit, and holding a credited release pays no repeat bonus. Add 5 at the clean episode horizon if the same quiet detached window is present and the measured robot range ratio is below 1.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R34 C5 at 185.799M continued steps. Exact deployment across 64 fixed starts gives 64 lifts, 42 active turns, 42 carries and zero complete placements, with six travel trials (four digit and three arm flags across six), zero stops and 13 final robot rests. Early finger violations are zero and early ring peak is .01108 rad. Across 38 first upright held supports, 33 attain controlled support, six are quiet while held, 34 relift and four break while supported. Whole-episode scan finds one quiet release from 1.87 to 30 s at seed 999087. It maintains the object rest at [.4892,.1057,-.2935] m and passes all hardware limits, but terminal wrist and finger ranges are 82.6 mm and 1.0085 rad. In 15 separate, initialized detached holdouts, all regain contact (median .15 s), all later quiet, four final object rests, three final robot rests, two simultaneous, zero faults or stops. The parent has three simultaneous in that matched test. Seed 999087 and independent starts are under exact diagnostic review. Per-update timings cover all four L40S. Exact evaluation and criteria are unchanged.

body.text: Exact paired replay of R34 C5 seed 999087 (r0456). Original object quiet detached 1.87–30 s, fixed final [.48920,.10575,−.29354] m with no safety issues. It fails ordered placement because wrist range 82.6 mm and finger range 1.0085 rad exceed the rest limits. At 2.40 s a smooth diagnostic hold or hold then withdraw gives the same object pose, no renewed contact or faults, complete ordered and standard placements, wrist 2.7 mm and fingers .0018/.0022 rad. The exact learned motion has 830 eligible object-quiet windows, five inside both rest limits and 124 nonzero under the current dense rest shaping; median normalized range 3.74 and final 20.17. This supports studying rest after verified release even when its dense clipped term gives no credit. Interventions remain diagnostic. Evidence work/r34_c5_full_release_rest_controls.json and work/r34_c5_999087_rest_ranges_exact.json.

body.reflection: R34 endpoint at 212.677M continued steps. Exact 64 full deployments give 64 lifts, 47 active turns, 47 carries, zero ordered placements or successes, 13 hardware travel trials (two digit and eleven arm), zero stops, 15 final robot rests. Early ring peak .01195 rad and no early finger trips. Across 42 first upright held supports, 37 controlled, 11 briefly quiet while held, 38 relift and four detach while supported. Whole trace scan finds no half-second quiet or final object rest. Checkpoint C5 had one safe uninterrupted object release but failed both robot-rest limits. The endpoint in 15 detached holdouts gets seven final object and seven robot rests, five both, no faults or stops. All 15 contact again (median .15 s) before quiet. The matched parent had three both. The better detached suffix count did not carry over to a full-start gain. Four L40S ran 57 updates, 134,690 steps/s including initialization and 138,201 after two updates. Per-rank medians physics 12.470 s, controller 2.694, sensor .718, inference .142, feature encoding .141, reset 2.294, ramp .596, and optimization 3.806 including .766 gradient/statistics synchronization. 21 sampled complete episodes had clean contracts and no capacity overflow. No change passed a gate. Full profile work/ppo_gpu_34_terminal_robot_rest/full_run_rate.json. R35 tests the independently measured first-grip relift instead.

body.text: R34 C5 on a disjoint exact 64 full starts: 64 lifts, 49 active turns, 49 carries, zero placements, eight travel trials, zero stops, 16 robot rests. Its single final object rest is seed 467341124, quiet 2.18–8.66 s, one renewed contact, quiet until the end, final palm 3.8 mm and finger .1495 rad. Safe. Matched original commands versus diagnostic hold or hold then withdraw at 2.70 s. Both interventions preserve detached object placement and pass ordered and station rest without renewed contact or travel. In 12 alternate sensor histories on each of 467341124 and fixed seed 999087, both give two quiet episodes, one and zero final object rests, zero total successes, respectively. Faults two/one and stops one/zero. Of 49 first-grip linked seats across this cohort, 40 exceed 45 mm and 29 exceed 55 mm. Near-successes are isolated. Reports work/r34_c5_independent_whole_deployment_release_exact.json, work/r34_c5_independent_release_rest_controls.json and work/r34_c5_scene_*_sensor_repeats/report.json.

Training-only exploration after stable release. r0285 physical quiet-release holds pass 33 of 35 at sigma .025, one at .05 and zero from .10 to .35. r0405 shows lower noise on the existing actor alone does not prevent its early recontact. The proposed PPO option keeps sigma .35 until three consecutive true quiet detached support samples in the in-goal release phase, then uses .025 while the condition holds. Store each sample mask and use the same Gaussian scale in the likelihood ratio. The actor mean and contract deployment features are unchanged. Training would be labeled privileged because of the true-state exploration mask. A separate asymmetric critic option remains available. A small four-rank integration check combining both initially exposed a missing frozen log_std gradient in the collective. Freeze that parameter in this mode and synchronize trainable gradients only. The retry completes 53,952 active steps in two updates, 1.06% quiet masks on update two and KL .0171, no capacity issue. Export validates contract at .278 ms p99. Overlap with one R35 update is included in measured training time. No smoke weights kept or task-tested. Numerical mask and likelihood test is work/quiet_release_exploration_tensor_checks.json. Separate prospective rest shaping 1/(1+.5*range_ratio) raises occupancy .448→5.320 and 1.267→6.338 on the two C5 object-rest traces. That broadens dense credit while the very late threshold reward is still needed. No new rest formula used. Traces work/smooth_rest_reward_prospective_exact.json.

On 16 matched exact diagnostic starts nominal/delay-only/separate middle–ring contact plus delay give early finger excursions 0/3/0 and total travel 1/15/12. Delay-alone early faults are all ring MCP2 at .34 s with peak .02284 rad. The separate contact bracket peak early ring excess is .01724 rad, with the first later digit fault at 1.23 s. All lift, contact bracket nine turns and seven carries, zero placements or stops. This measures the revised pregrasp in two model variants and leaves late safety unresolved. It is neither physical confirmation nor a modification of the frozen evaluator. Evidence work/r34_c5_bare_pregrasp_gap_exact.json and work/r34_c5_finger_contact_brackets_exact.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. After the first four healthy controlled held support ticks in phase 4 or 5, charge each increase in the largest airborne held plug height above 45 mm from standing height. Scale excess over 25 mm and clip to [0,1], for up to 10 points per episode. End tracking at the first lost hand contact.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R35 C2 at 73.738M continued steps gives 64 lifts, 52 active turns, 52 carries and zero ordered placements on exact deployment64. Three travel trials (two fingers and one arm), zero stops, nine final robot rests and an early ring peak .01058 rad, no early finger trips. Whole-episode scan shows no quiet detached half-second or final object rest. Linked seats are 51 versus parent 55. Across 47 common linked seats median paired peak rise drops 7.72 mm, interval [-21.78,+.96], 28 lower, median peaks 61.14 versus 49.98 mm, with 28 versus 21 above 55 mm. All linked seats counts over 55 mm are 32/55 versus 22/51. The first-upright-touch subset has 44 supports, 38 controlled, 15 briefly quiet while held, 38 later support losses and six still supported at first detachment. Detached holdout15 all recontact median .15 s, 14 later quiet, four final object and four robot rests, zero simultaneous and no faults/stops. Peak height is moving in the intended direction with fewer linked seats and no complete success. Keep the run, measure later updates, and judge gate only on exact results. The rate and decompositions are measured across all four L40S.

body.text: Paired exact 4 s exploration diagnostic on 40 independent R34 C5 first-touch-upright contexts. The deterministic replay reproduces all 40 command prefixes exactly. After four controlled held-support samples, apply 24 steps of white Gaussian or AR(1) Gaussian with .94 autocorrelation, matched marginal SD and two draws per scene. At .35 neither gets quiet release and among 66 jointly safe pairs coherent peak delta is +.96 mm (31 lower); coherent incurs five stops, white zero. At 1.0, white two quiet and coherent one, safe; stops three versus 20. The smaller coherent peak at 1.0 persists in jointly safe pairs (−10.39 mm) but has no quiet-release benefit. Do not start PPO using these options. Report work/r34_c5_independent_coherent_noise/report.json and paired_healthy_summary.json. Separate expanded first-grip measurements work/all_first_grip_touchdown_followup_exact.json include upright support after a tilted first touch. Old touchdown summaries explicitly cover first touch already upright. The current R34 C5 independent near-success 467341124 has only three consecutive controlled samples in the original grip, though it achieves linked seat and sustained release and fails only robot rest. Fixed 999087 has six and R26 C5 success eight. Four-tick control remains useful, but a reward-only fallback for a prior linked upright supported grip followed by actual quiet separation could cover 467341124 before later recontact.

Queue R36 quiet-release exploration after R35 finishes. Start from r0456 R34 C5 and matching Adam; keep R34 reward including revocable release and terminal rest, existing curriculum, unchanged encoder history, .70 deployment, .35 noise on all earlier or unsafe states, .000044 LR, same objective and randomization. Lower only latent exploration to .025 after three consecutive quiet detached in-goal samples in release phase. The observations and deterministic exported actor are contract v3. The replay evidence r0457 and r0459 motivates the rest branch, r0285 motivates quiet sigma, and r0460 validates actor independence and likelihood. No asymmetric critic. 4×12,288 worlds, every update profiled, two separate measured terminal-rest outcome counters and quiet-mask share. Expect sampled quiet states to retain enough motor rest to deliver a terminal learning signal, with exact fixed and independent deployments deciding whether that changes early release or success. Startup work/ppo_gpu_36_quiet_release_noise, trainer PID1477055 waiting R35 PID1446792, watcher plug_r36_watch. Frozen exact station and gates unchanged.

body.text: R35 C3 seed 106472 quiet 2.10–8.70 s, then renewed contact at 8.71. Original misses final detached object and robot rest. On exact replay at 2.633 s, a diagnostic hold or hold followed by withdrawal preserves ordered placement, both rests, safety and no recontact, with final palm/fingers 1.4 mm/.0036 rad or zero/zero. Across six separate exact initial quiet intervals from R26, R30, R31, two R34 scenes and R35, the observation has zero valid object poses during the first quiet half-second (0 of 91 policy samples) and near first upright support. Across all true quiet policy samples in these trajectories 4,399/4,838 valid estimates as the sensor recovers. Last half-second valid in all six. Together this shows an initial fully occluded release period and later substantial estimator access. Contract actor needs proprioceptive inference through the early window and the exact object pose remains inaccessible. The diagnostic holds are outside the policy. Evidence work/r35_c3_full_release_rest_controls.json and work/quiet_release_observability_exact.json.

body.reflection: R35 C4 at 148.140M continued steps. Exact fixed64 gives 64 lifts, 51 active turns, 50 carries, zero placements or successes, zero travel violations and zero stops, ten final robot rests and .483 ms act p99. The same fixed scenes for incumbent r0106 give 64/37/25/0, with zero faults and stops. Compared to immediate parent R33 C3, linked seats 47 versus 55. The 42 common linked seats have a paired median peak rise change of −24.19 mm, interval [−39.45,−17.79], and peaks above 55 mm down from 24 to two. Entire linked cohort 3/47 versus 32/55 above 55 mm. In the first-touch-upright subset, 30 held supports, 23 controlled, six briefly quiet, 23 support losses while held and seven detach while supported. Whole64 has zero sustained quiet or final object rests. In detached holdout15 all recontact then quiet, four final objects and three robot rests, one simultaneous, safe. Candidate selected for a fresh carry gate against official incumbent because it doubles exact fixed carry and has clean local safety, with the most recent relift reduction improving the physical approach to placement but no full-start completion. Research parent is ahead in carry in this exact set. The gate assesses the aggregate changes since the incumbent. Four L40S with measured throughput and a timing breakdown.
