body.text: Operator convergence direction. LEARNING.md section 2 explicitly forbids teacher-action supervision, distillation and DAgger, and the operator kept the experiment rules. Use the demonstrated brake/open/withdraw/hold physical states already prepared in the 499-state curriculum and the previously checked PPO objectives. No action labels enter training. Supersede the queued R34-derived quiet-noise run before it starts. R36 now starts from R35 C4 r0468 and matching Adam, which had 50 carries and zero travel/stops on the fixed64 and is already in fresh carry gate gate-20261123T122033Z-so4x. Keep first-grip relift and existing turn/carry/seat. Combine validated R34 revocable release, terminal robot rest, conditional quiet exploration .025 with .35 elsewhere, and phase-4/5 weights .100/.550. Other guided weights .150/.080/.065/.055, .70 deployment retained, same 499-state bank and sensor cache. This is a combined convergence run, so individual effects are confounded. 35 minutes four L40S of 12,288 each, exact station unchanged. PID1489603 waits for R35, watcher plug_r36_watch, work/ppo_gpu_36_converge_release. Aim latest eligible candidate gate by 14:30 UTC, operator cutoff 15:23 UTC even though record clock includes waits and shows later. Keep time for final gate, verification and reflection.

Parent selection for operator convergence. The highest fixed64 safe carry count alone was R28 C2 r0380 (54 carries, zero travel). The matched independent64 gives R28 50 carries and three travels versus R35 C4 55 and two. Across the two nominal sets, C4 is 105/128 carries and two travels versus R28 104/128 and three. Both zero stops. C4 also wins the mapped separate 16-start contact bracket in travel 14 versus 16, with early zero for both, and its independent matched linked seat gives median paired peak −11.58 mm [−18.87,−7.11] versus R28. Neither has a qualifying placement. This favors R35 C4, now confirmed R36 origin. Late finger safety remains weak in the contact bracket. Data work/r35_c4_independent_eval/scored.json, work/r35_c4_independent_paired_r28_peaks_exact.json and work/r35_c4_finger_contact_brackets_exact.json.

architecture.actor: 160 and 160 tanh hidden units with a 26-dimensional latent action
architecture.critic: Shared trunk with scalar value head, deployment observations only Restored from checkpoint.
architecture.action: Bounded translation, rotation-vector and finger target changes from previous targets, followed by hardware box and finger limits. Palm pose lead is limited to 0.066 m and 0.32 rad from delayed proprioception.
architecture.pose_input_preprocessing: The actor uses the empty-cache pose feature when the estimate is invalid and sensor-reported age is at least 0.8 s. Validity and age stay as measured.
architecture.hand_tracking_input: Twenty encoder-minus-expected-angle residuals, estimated from prior contract hand targets using the nominal 2 Hz filter and combined command and proprioception delay. The filter resets with the observation history and reads no time or contact field.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. After the first four healthy controlled held support ticks in phase 4 or 5, charge each increase in the largest airborne held plug height above 45 mm from standing height. Scale excess over 25 mm and clip to [0,1], for up to 10 points per episode. End tracking at the first lost hand contact.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry, seat and release bonuses 4, 6, 10, 12, 14 and 30. The seat bonus and transition to release require four consecutive 100 Hz samples of upright in-zone table and hand contact with plug speed at most .12 m/s and spin at most 6 rad/s. The training carry bonus and transition to seat require a held, controlled handoff within 35 mm of standing height. Scale the held carry milestone by the controlled-seat quality .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2) at its qualifying handoff. Linear excess is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s. Angular excess is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s. Both excesses are floored at zero. The object and palm target must advance at least 5 mm toward positive y from the start of carry, and the measured palm advances at least half the object distance.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R35 endpoint at 200.848M continued active steps. Exact fixed64 gives 64 lifts, 44 turns, 44 carries, zero ordered placements or successes, one finger and one arm travel, zero stops and 14 final robot rests. .289 ms act p99, .00927 rad max early ring and no early digit trips. body.reflection: R36 C1 at 36.376M continued steps. The convergence run retains R35 C4 network, Adam and first-grip relift shaping. It increases guided phase-four and phase-five sampling, uses the 499 physical reset states, adds the validated revocable release and terminal robot rest rewards, and lowers exploration only after measured quiet detached support. The rule uses simulator state only in PPO sampling, so the iteration is privileged; the single actor uses contract observations and produces the entire action at deployment. Exact fixed64 gives 64 lifts, 48 active turns, 48 carries, zero ordered placements, three digit travels, no arm travel or stops, 13 final robot rests, .282 ms act p99. No early travel, ring max .01133 rad. 48 first-grip linked supports versus 47 from parent, with four versus three above 55 mm. On 37 shared linked seats paired peak delta −1.30 mm, interval [−8.78,+4.08], two each above 55 mm. Expanded first-grip scan shows 37 controlled and six briefly quiet while held, 39 later support losses and 11 detach supported. Whole64 shows no half-second quiet object or final object rest. In 15 detached holdouts all touch again (median .15 s), all later quiet, no final objects, eight hand/palm rests, zero simultaneous, no safety issue. Checkpoint precedes the full horizon reset wave. Four L40S with every update profiled and end-to-end steps per second, unchanged exact gate.

body.hypothesis: R35 C4 tests the cumulative causal turn and low, height-and-speed-guided carry training since incumbent r0106, with the new first-grip relift shaping after seating. Expect more qualifying held upright carries than r0106. On the fixed starts the candidate carries 50/64 versus 25/64 with no travel violations or stops in either. The latest relift term reduces the matched post-seat peak by 24.19 mm versus its immediate parent, alongside a carry reduction versus that parent. Fixed placements remain zero, so this is a carry-stage comparison.
body.observed: In r0358 gate-20261123T074912Z-jad9, seed 558929653 shows the plug held at 0.46 s and lying flat separated at 4.38 s. Seed 1020909259 stands apart at 4.38 s and the hand approaches again by 8.34 s. These frames show loss of a stable upright finish; their spacing does not resolve touchdown. The new exact traces check whether upright carry is sustained into low supported transfer.
body.success_rule: every stage, at rest over the last 0.5 s (finger joint range <= 0.05 rad, palm range <= 0.005 m), hardware within limits, no stop

body.text: Gate r0474 rejected R35 C4 on 96 fresh exact paired starts. Candidate/incumbent stages lift 96/96, turn79/64, carry78/43, place0/0; carry discordant gains41/losses6, p=8.9e−8. Seven trial-level travel violations versus zero, no stops, reproducible and act p99 .298 ms. The local clean64 was insufficient to predict fresh-seed safety. Opened both montage files: seeds 558595728 and 737534127 have the plug among the digits at displayed .46 s and on a broad face separated at 4.38 s. Wrist and fingers remain nearby and change posture in later frames. Early touchdown timing is unresolved in the strip. Incumbent remains r0106 and this package does not qualify for target submission. C4 is a training checkpoint for R36 only. Separate issue: R36 early optimizer median 4.5 minibatches versus a 960-update opportunity, recent updates 2–4 because the lower release exploration makes the likelihood KL narrow. This inflates measured throughput while PPO uses little batch data. Check a reduced step size and retain the convergence objective.

architecture.action: Bounded translation, rotation-vector and finger target changes from previous targets, followed by hardware box and finger limits. Palm pose lead is limited to 0.066 m and 0.32 rad from delayed proprioception.
architecture.actor_observations: Contract-v3 observations and their recorded history
architecture.pose_input_preprocessing: The actor uses the empty-cache pose feature when the estimate is invalid and sensor-reported age is at least 0.8 s. Validity and age stay as measured.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. Once the phase-5 plug is quiet, upright, detached and supported in the goal for 51 consecutive 100 Hz samples, compute the larger of maximum finger range divided by .05 rad and palm range divided by .005 m. Credit .02 per active policy sample times one minus half this ratio, clipped to [0,1]. After the first four healthy controlled held support ticks in phase 4 or 5, charge each increase in the largest airborne held plug height above 45 mm from standing height. Scale excess over 25 mm and clip to [0,1], for up to 10 points per episode. End tracking at the first lost hand contact.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry and seat bonuses of 4, 6, 10, 12 and 14. The phase-5 milestone credits 30 points after 15 consecutive active policy samples of quiet detached support in the goal. Three consecutive active samples with a failed release condition debit 30 points. A fresh 15-sample quiet release restores the credit, and holding a credited release pays no repeat bonus. Add 5 at the clean episode horizon if the same quiet detached window is present and the measured robot range ratio is below 1.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge .25 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 3 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: R36 C2 at 73.501M continued steps. Exact fixed64 gives 64 lifts, 44 turns, 44 carries, zero ordered placements or successes, three travel trials (two fingers, one arm), zero stops and 11 final robot rests. No early digit violations; max early ring .01073 rad. No half-second quiet release or final object over any full deployment. Linked seats 44 versus parent's 47. On 31 shared links the median peak delta is +3.50 mm, interval [−3.94,+9.82], one versus two above 55 mm. Expanded first-grip touchdown gives 36 controlled, nine briefly quiet while held, 36 later support losses and eight detach supported. Detached15 all recontact and all later quiet, two terminal object and five robot rests, one combined, safe. Sampled training began reaching physical simultaneous terminal rest, but the result has not transferred to the deterministic exact assessment. Current updates often use two to four PPO minibatches because KL triggers an early stop with the narrow quiet-state exploration. That truncation explains part of the measured throughput rise. Adjust optimizer step size on the same objective before continuing. All four profiled L40S and the frozen station.

body.text: Convergence optimizer repair after R36 C3 save, keeping training objective and root R35 C4. Measured R36 median of 4.5 optimizer minibatches on first ten updates and two to four on updates15–24 explains some higher steps/s. CPU replay of PPO updates on a fixed synthetic-advantage batch of 65,536 deployment features from the existing physical reset bank, around 7% quiet-mask samples, copied actor and Adam. .000044 uses 6 and 8 of 64 minibatches for R35 C4 and R36 C2 state, analytic final KL .03975 and .08148. .000006 uses all 64, KL .00444 and .00529. No probe weights retained, work/quiet_release_learning_rate_probe.json. R37 will run the same release objective from C4 and Adam on four L40S with .000006 LR, for up to 40 minutes. Record every exact checkpoint and compare live KL/minibatch use before further work. Stop R36 after atomic C3 and finish its exact evaluation; no pending gate or target. This repairs the existing approach instead of introducing a new skill hypothesis.

body.reflection: R36 C3 at 110.671M is the last saved model before the deliberate numerical restart. Exact fixed64 gives 64 lifts, 53 turns, 53 carries and zero finished placements, three later digit travels, no arm travel or stops, 13 final robot rests and .335 ms p99. Early ring .01167 rad with zero early excursions. Of 53 linked seats, 47 controlled, 15 briefly quiet while held, 47 later lose support and six detach still supported. Across 41 matched linked seats against C4 the paired peak delta is +1.85 mm [−.92,+8.48], three per side beyond 55 mm. Whole64 finds a single safe quiet release 2.16–4.11 s at seed 1017810, with neither final object rest nor final robot rest. Detached15 all recontact and later quiet, three final object and three robot rests, two both, no faults or stops. Start-state labels and teacher actions are absent; the policy is one network conditioned on contract observations. No official gate from R36. Saved rollout through update 30; stop arrived after update 32 telemetry, at 118.486M without a later export. Four GPU full telemetry 154,409 inclusive and 164,468 warm steps/s. Median CUDA per rank physics12.164 s, controls2.683, sensor.771, inference.150, resets2.159 and optimizer.0199 including .0047 sync. This reflects early KL cutoff, not equivalent optimization. No sampled contract issue or capacity overflow. Resume matched R35 C4 Adam with the same study at a lower step size, as in r0477.

body.text: r0474 travel cause follow-up uses its public per-trial outcomes and six different local sensor histories per failing scene, 42 exact station replays. Four actual gate failures were finger excursions (.02005–.03050 rad) and three were arm travel. With alternate histories there are zero arm-limit repeats and three digit faults, all held, one supported. The cases occur at 1.64/1.76/1.85 s after grasp: pinky MCP2 pushed below the lower limit against a +.25 rad target, thumb DIP near its upper target, thumb PIP near its lower target. These are different from [redacted] early ring collisions. New sensor histories cannot establish times for the original gate faults. Evidence work/r0474_fault_replay_exact/diagnostics.json. R37 numerical repair live first three updates uses 416/840/928 PPO minibatches per rank with KL .00374/.00323/.00342, and third update end-to-end 140108.6 steps/s on four L40S. Continue the same convergence run.

R36 C3 exact seed1017810 is a separate transient release. Quiet 2.16–4.11 s with renewed contact at 4.12 and failed terminal object and wrist rest. A diagnostic hold after the first quiet half-second preserves the exact ordered place and all safety, no renewed contact, final palm 4.1 mm and fingers .0019 rad. The matched slow withdrawal avoids contact but fails wrist rest with 8.3 mm range. The controls are evidence for learning to settle after release and are not policy outputs or training labels. work/r36_c3_1017810_release_controls_exact.json. R37 latest short profile has 480–960 minibatches per GPU at recovered learning rate.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. Credit .02 per active policy sample times one minus half this ratio, clipped to [0,1]. After the first four healthy controlled held support ticks in phase 4 or 5, charge each increase in the largest airborne held plug height above 45 mm from standing height. Scale excess over 25 mm and clip to [0,1], for up to 10 points per episode. End tracking at the first lost hand contact.

body.text: Exact R37 C2/C3 hardware timing. Four local post-manipulation J2 excursions at 5.10–16.98 seconds occur when the hand is detached, although one episode later recontacts. The existing r0264 inward-3-degree detached-arm reward would charge during the preceding 0.30 s for all four (0.0417–0.0809 points before the fault). This is sensitivity evidence. The cost is common on healthy starts (C4 parent median 1.86, R37 C3 median 2.26), and the isolated full R26 success would also pay 3.67. Leave R37 unchanged. The R37 C3 index DIP fault is while held and supported at 1.53 s, outside the detached measure. Evidence work/r37_c1_to_c3_detached_arm_prospective_exact.json and work/r37_c3_hardware_timing_exact.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. Once the phase-5 plug is quiet, upright, detached and supported in the goal for 51 consecutive 100 Hz samples, compute the larger of maximum finger range divided by .05 rad and palm range divided by .005 m. Credit .02 per active policy sample times one minus half this ratio, clipped to [0,1]. After the first four healthy controlled held support ticks in phase 4 or 5, charge each increase in the largest airborne held plug height above 45 mm from standing height. Scale excess over 25 mm and clip to [0,1], for up to 10 points per episode. End tracking at the first lost hand contact.

body.text: Queue final planned convergence block R38 from R37 C6 r0488 and matching Adam after R37 finishes. The active R36/R37 convergence correctly began from the lower-travel R35 C4. For this continuation C6 has two safe terminal object-rest near-misses on disjoint nominal 64-start sets, and 110/128 carries versus R35 C4 105/128, with travel 9 versus 2. Its local finger travel is the main regression (4 on each exact set). Fresh gate r0474 earlier confirmed 4 digit and 3 arm violations; montages showed the plug lying on a broad face and remaining hand movement. Keep R37 objective, curriculum, .000006 LR, conditional .025 exploration and actor, strengthen the existing measured/forecast digit regularity by factor two (.50 increment, 6 cap), and enable the existing 3 degree detached arm reserve r0264. These are two declared safety reward settings, applied together to address the measured categories. Same angle geometry and frozen judge. CPU proof of exact scaling and static/inward zero is work/digit_travel_weight_tensor_checks.json; physical controls for the base digit term r0381, and arm sensitivity r0485. This is tightening documented risks, with no new skill branch. Four L40S, 44 minutes, selection before 14:30Z. Will consider later R37 checkpoints for parent replacement before launch only if they materially improve safe ordered outcomes.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. Once the phase-5 plug is quiet, upright, detached and supported in the goal for 51 consecutive 100 Hz samples, compute the larger of maximum finger range divided by .05 rad and palm range divided by .005 m. Credit .02 per active policy sample times one minus half this ratio, clipped to [0,1]. After the first four healthy controlled held support ticks in phase 4 or 5, charge each increase in the largest airborne held plug height above 45 mm from standing height. Scale excess over 25 mm and clip to [0,1], for up to 10 points per episode. End tracking at the first lost hand contact.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry and seat bonuses of 4, 6, 10, 12 and 14. Add 5 at the clean episode horizon if the same quiet detached window is present and the measured robot range ratio is below 1.

Four L40S averaged 139,366 active environment steps/s inclusive and 142,346 after warmup. Physics took a median 12.752 s per update, with 2.670 s control, .720 s sensor, .145 s inference, 2.313 s reset and 3.313 s optimization including .692 s gradient synchronization. See work/r37_c9_*_exact.json.

body.reflection: The existing measured finger-margin weight doubled and the detached arm-margin term was enabled, keeping the same R37 C6 initialization and release reward. This 36.388M-step cut gave 64 lifts, 52 turns, 52 carries, one safe ordered placement, two separate travel violations and zero stops. Seed 44664 was quiet at 2.30–4.22 s and had detached object and robot rest at the end. Four fixed trials had a quiet interval and two had final object rest. The 44 common linked seats changed rebound by a median −1.31 mm. `None` exceeded 55 mm, versus three on the parent. Fifteen detached holdouts all recontacted, then one achieved both final rests. Model testing remains exact nominal station. The operator authorized a separate local teacher experiment and asked to retain r0106 on the gate line. See work/r38_c1_*_exact.json.

reward_terms.name: approach
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of approach potential from housing-to-palm position, wrist angle and two intended pads near the housing.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: New clearance potential of a gripped object, gated by opposed contact and referenced to 14 mm.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: New maximum of the minimum of world blade-up progress and signed tilt reduction attributable to relative angle changes; paid only while continuously opposed, unsupported, and the contact digits have measured and commanded motion. Common wrist rotation cancels in the relative measurement.

reward_terms.name: carry
reward_terms.formula: Planar progress with weight 9 is multiplied by 0.25 + 0.75 times the measured height quality. Up to 6 points of causal height progress are added. The height target interpolates the reconstructed transfer at the current lateral position, with 10 mm tolerance and 100 mm Gaussian scale. The upright plug remains held and unsupported through all controller ticks, the palm moves at least half as far as the object in the same vertical direction and its target changes in that direction. Only a new height-quality maximum pays. Each new height-quality minimum during an upright, held and unsupported transfer costs four times the decrease below the previous minimum. The level at entry is free. During held unsupported carry with blade tilt at most 25 degrees, charge .45 times the seat speed-quality deficit at each sample. The planar weight falls linearly from one at 40 mm outside the goal to zero at 100 mm. Height weight falls from one at 70 mm from standing height to zero at 100 mm. The charge is capped at 4 points per episode.

reward_terms.name: seat
reward_terms.formula: New combined seating potential. Height score uses a 2 mm tolerance and 100 mm scale. Height credit requires an actual decrease in height error with downward movement at the palm of at least half of that distance, a descending target, blades within 25 degrees and contact preserved across controller ticks. Both policy samples are inside the goal. Tilt guidance keeps its existing scale. The potential starts at the measured entry value. The potential is multiplied by .35 + .65/(1 + linear^2 + angular^2), where linear is speed above .12 + 2.5*min(height error, .055) m/s divided by .20 m/s and angular is spin above 6 rad/s divided by 6 rad/s, both floored at zero.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: New gain in removal of hand contact and supported upright rest. Once the phase-5 plug is quiet, upright, detached and supported in the goal for 51 consecutive 100 Hz samples, compute the larger of maximum finger range divided by .05 rad and palm range divided by .005 m. Credit .02 per active policy sample times one minus half this ratio, clipped to [0,1]. After the first four healthy controlled held support ticks in phase 4 or 5, charge each increase in the largest airborne held plug height above 45 mm from standing height. Scale excess over 25 mm and clip to [0,1], for up to 10 points per episode. End tracking at the first lost hand contact.

reward_terms.name: reference_object
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in position and blade-axis agreement with the adapted reconstruction. Position and axis jointly use a 14 mm-equivalent tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_wrist
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in wrist position and orientation agreement with the adapted dense reconstruction. Airborne tolerance 83 mm and 0.70 rad, other phases 44 mm and 0.34 rad.

reward_terms.name: reference_posture
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in five-digit demonstrated flexion agreement with 0.53 rad RMS tolerance.

reward_terms.name: reference_contact
reward_terms.formula: Progress-conditioned gain in object-frame contact agreement with reconstructed witnesses within a 9 mm free band.

reward_terms.name: bonus
reward_terms.formula: One-time ordered approach, lift, turn, carry and seat bonuses of 4, 6, 10, 12 and 14. The phase-5 milestone credits 30 points after 15 consecutive active policy samples of quiet detached support in the goal. Three consecutive active samples with a failed release condition debit 30 points. A fresh 15-sample quiet release restores the credit, and holding a credited release pays no repeat bonus. Add 5 at the clean episode horizon if the same quiet detached window is present and the measured robot range ratio is below 1.

reward_terms.name: slip
reward_terms.formula: Negative blade-angle displacement past 0.10 degree when an opposed grip moves the object with nearly stationary finger joints.

reward_terms.name: regularity
reward_terms.formula: Negative mean absolute target change, metres and radians. On each active healthy 100 Hz sample, compute squared normalized measured travel beyond each finger limit, with a 0.005 rad onset and saturation at the 0.020 rad allowance. For each bound where the sent target is within 0.025 rad, project the encoder angle forward 0.010 s with its simulated velocity. Use measured angle elsewhere. Charge 0.5 times the maximum positive increase across digits, capped at 6 points per episode. Stationary risk and decreasing risk cost zero. After at least .12 s of continuous detachment following an unsupported grip, each 100 Hz sample costs .035 times the largest positive change across squared normalized deficits inside a 3 degree reserve on arm travel and wrist coupling, capped at 4 points per episode. Stationary positions, inward travel and renewed contact add no charge.

reward_terms.name: stop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty at station stop or hardware violation.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Penalty on a dropped plug that settles unturned during the supported manipulation.

body.reflection: The 73.541M-step safety continuation gave 64 lifts, 55 turns and carries, no placement, three travels, no stops and eight robot rests on exact fixed starts. In 48 common linked seats rebound changed by a median +1.23 mm and two vs four peaks exceeded 55 mm. One transient quiet release and no final object rests occurred. On 15 detached holdouts all recontacted, and one eventually met both rest measurements, with no travels or stops. C1 had stronger task and hardware outcomes. PPO was stopped at a saved checkpoint for the operator-authorized BC/DAgger trial. Across 25 complete sampled updates, training yielded 119,442 env steps/s inclusive or 125,021 warm on four L40S, with a median 11.939 s physics, .183 s inference, 2.398 s resets, 4.418 s optimizer time including 1.089 s sync. See work/r38_c2_*_exact.json.

body.text: Operator note #4 authorized an isolated BC/DAgger experiment after the PPO line. r0106 is the only available official final incumbent; its unchanged package was queued for the final gate. PPO r0495 is the student warm start because exact64 has a safe completed placement and two travels amid 52 carries. The slowed full feasibility teacher gave 24 lifts and zero placements in its pilot. The existing fixed brake/open/withdraw/hold teacher completed 67 of 74 controlled held seats. It prescribes 26 degree/s arm joint increments, with slow private actuator limits for label collection only. Fifty successful tails measured at most 34.2 degree/s after .38 s of braking, though inherited momentum can exceed that bound during braking. Their labels use simulator state. The single student reads only contract-v3 observations except time and is evaluated in the unchanged frozen station using delayed and stale estimates. BC epoch45 produced two exact ordered placements, nine travels and 11 stops. Collect DAgger labels on actual learner states after first seat and long stationary tails to address target drift; reduce the teacher mix and preserve prefix actions. Teacher-trained packages remain local.

body.reflection: Initial supervised cut after 15 epochs. Teacher loss dropped substantially relative to initialization, but the exact 64 starts showed zero full placements, 50 carries, eight travel violations and 29 arm collision stops. The released hand continued to oscillate and the batch arm speed p95 was 58.4 degrees/s. The first-cut fit did not transfer to stable long rollouts.
